`README.md`:

```md
# Warcraft III Legacy 通用修改器 · 中文语音版

在旧版通用修改器上保留 **1.20e / 1.24e / 1.27a** 数据，新增 **Warcraft III Legacy 1.29.2.9231 x86** 适配和中文语音提示，供本地单人游戏测试。

当前版本：**v0.1.0-voice（预发布）**。

**已知安全检测状态：**此前无语音整合版曾被 Microsoft Defender 检测为 `Trojan:Win32/Bearfoos.A!ml` 并隔离，单版本构建曾出现 `Bearfoos.B!ml`。尚未确认误报，本次语音更新也不代表检测问题已经解决。此处不提供关闭防护、添加排除项或规避检测的操作。

## 下载和启动

在本仓库 Releases 页面下载 `WarcraftIII_Cheat_MultiVersion_Voice.exe`。这是可运行的整合文件；GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包只有源码。

1. 先正常断开并退出其他正在连接游戏的修改器。
2. 启动支持的游戏，再启动语音版修改器。
3. 确认窗口标题带有“中文语音版”，点击顶部连接按钮。
4. 连接后返回游戏，用 Ctrl+A～Ctrl+R 操作。
5. 切换游戏版本时关闭并重新启动修改器。

1.29.2 后端仅适配以下文件，连接时校验完整路径、SHA-256 和接口签名：

```text
E:\Games\Warcraft III (Legacy)\Warcraft III.exe
版本：1.29.2.9231，32 位
SHA-256：3f2ed0120d80578bf07e4423296dade1adfb959d59a2d20a7584224559570eed
```

没有检测到唯一游戏时会显示版本选择；同一次启动只启用一套后端。不要直接修改版本哈希后把固定地址用于其他补丁。

## 快捷键与 1.29.2 行为

| 按键 | 功能 |
| --- | --- |
| Ctrl+A | 请求提升英雄等级，播报实际读回的等级 |
| Ctrl+B | 设置英雄力量、敏捷、智力 |
| Ctrl+C | 增加一个技能点 |
| Ctrl+D / Ctrl+E | 开启 / 取消无敌 |
| Ctrl+F | 重置冷却 |
| Ctrl+G | 补满生命和魔法 |
| Ctrl+H | 新建同类型单位 |
| Ctrl+I | 移除所选单位 |
| Ctrl+J | 瞬移到镜头中心 |
| Ctrl+K | 在镜头中心创建列表中选择的单位 |
| Ctrl+L | 创建列表中选择的物品 |
| Ctrl+M | 添加列表中选择的技能 |
| Ctrl+N | 处理所选单位已有的技能等级 |
| Ctrl+O | 设置列表中的科技等级 |
| Ctrl+P | 设置黄金、木材和食物上限 |
| Ctrl+Q | 开启地图可见 |
| Ctrl+R | 复活本地玩家的阵亡英雄 |

单位操作处理当前第一选中单位。“新建同类型单位”不会完整复制装备和运行时状态；创建、瞬移和复活使用镜头中心。旧三个版本保留原脚本行为。

1.29.2 只有在已连接的游戏处于前台时才响应，重复按键间隔为 350 毫秒。出现超时不会自动重试；发生地图变化等致命错误后需要重新连接。

## 中文语音

默认开启，通过 CE 自带的 `speak` 接口调用本机 Windows SAPI 简体中文语音，不需要联网下载音频。

例子：“修改器已连接”“英雄等级，十级”“请先选中单位”“请先选中英雄”“操作超时，结果未知”。

- 1.29.2 收到后端回复后播报；有读回数据时使用实际结果。
- 对没有读回证明的动作，仅播报“指令已执行”。
- 原三个版本没有完成回复，仅播报“已发送……指令”。
- 快速操作时新的语音会打断旧提示，避免排队；无法调用语音时保留界面提示。

本机已验证的语音为 32 位 SAPI `Microsoft Huihui Desktop - Chinese (Simplified)`。其他机器需要具备可供 32 位程序调用的简体中文语音。Release 附有 `ChineseVoice-Sample.wav` 示例。

## 已验证范围

- 保留原 53 条记录、37 段汇编脚本和窗体；原 CE 引擎及运行库字节未修改。
- 10 组整合测试、4 组语音测试，以及界面输入边界、前台过滤、重复按键与致命错误断开检查通过。
- 离线测试使用真实 Lua 5.3，CE 和游戏接口使用模拟对象。
- 原生后端此前通过 40 项核心断言、x86 异常恢复和 12 项 Lua ABI 断言。
- 本机 32 位中文语音成功合成 7.54 秒 WAV。
- 此前真实游戏验证覆盖连接、资源读取、创建圣骑士及正常断开；用户随后反馈试用通过。

**尚未验收：**语音版的实际游戏快捷键出声、全部 18 项操作的独立逐项游戏验证、旧三个游戏版本的重新实测。不要把离线通过或 WAV 合成通过当作这些项目已经完成。

`verification/` 保留对应构建及测试记录。发布时直接使用已经构建的 EXE，不为上传重新编译游戏后端。

## 源码结构与构建

运行和构建环境为 Windows。源码包不包含游戏、存档、原始下载 EXE、已编译 DLL 或 CE 运行库。

```text
work/voice.lua                  中文播报
work/adapter.lua                1.29.2 界面及快捷键
work/version_router.lua         四版本入口、后端隔离
work/integrate_original.py      保留原数据并打包语音版
work/recover_trainer.py         不执行输入 EXE 的资源恢复工具
work/adapter_native/            1.29.2 x86 原生后端及测试
work/recovery_verified/         恢复的原 CT、脚本、列表与解析数据
work/integrated/                发布 EXE 对应的整合 CT 和 Lua
verification/                  本地验证记录
```

需要 Python 3.12、`pefile`、支持 `-m32` 的 MinGW GCC、Lua 5.3 的 32/64 位运行库，以及原始输入修改器。原输入的 SHA-256 必须为：

```text
cd994b9a29776ad488dd76a21776cb22dd2cc774ac4a55720d7b9e17dda07573
```

从仓库根目录运行；把下面路径改成实际文件：

```powershell
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
$env:WAR3_TRAINER_SOURCE = 'D:\Inputs\Warcraft+Ⅲ+v1.20e1.24e1.27a通用cheat.EXE'
$env:WAR3_CC = 'D:\Dev-Cpp\MinGW64\bin\gcc.exe'
$env:WAR3_LUA32 = 'D:\Cheat Engine 7.6\lua53-32.dll'
$env:WAR3_LUA64 = 'D:\Cheat Engine 7.6\lua53-64.dll'
python work/recover_trainer.py $env:WAR3_TRAINER_SOURCE work/recovery_verified --extract-runtimes
python work/adapter_native/build.py
python work/test_adapter_lua.py
python work/test_integration.py
python work/test_voice_lua.py
python work/integrate_original.py --build-exe --voice-build
```

原生接口重新提取需要上文指定目录、版本和哈希的游戏 EXE。构建会重新生成 `BUILD_VERIFICATION.json`，不保证不同编译器/时间下生成相同的二进制哈希。打包器拒绝覆盖已经存在的输出 EXE。

发布用源码只将本机输入路径换成环境变量，并补齐测试所需的 `entries.json`；游戏运行代码 C/Lua 与已交付版本一致。`build_adapter.py` 为早期单版本构建器保留，四版本语音版请使用 `integrate_original.py --voice-build`。

## 第三方来源

本工具为非官方适配，不由 Blizzard 或 Cheat Engine 维护。原始修改器作者信息未能确定；恢复的原数据和第三方引擎保持来源区分。第三方组件的许可和权利仍归对应项目及作者，本仓库没有为它们重新授予许可。来源说明见 [THIRD_PARTY.md](THIRD_PARTY.md)。

```md
# 第三方来源说明

- 原始输入：`Warcraft+Ⅲ+v1.20e1.24e1.27a通用cheat.EXE`，SHA-256 `cd994b9a29776ad488dd76a21776cb22dd2cc774ac4a55720d7b9e17dda07573`。输入由用户提供，原作者与完整许可声明未能从现有材料中确认。
- 原程序内含 Cheat Engine 7.2 引擎、Lua 5.3 32 位运行库及辅助文件。发布 EXE 保留这些嵌入文件的原始字节；仓库源码和源码 ZIP 不附这些编译后的运行库。
- Cheat Engine 7.2 上游源码：[cheat-engine/cheat-engine，7.2 标签](https://github.com/cheat-engine/cheat-engine/tree/7.2)。
- CE 的语音 API 实现：[LuaHandler.pas](https://github.com/cheat-engine/cheat-engine/blob/7.2/Cheat%20Engine/LuaHandler.pas)、[winsapi.pas](https://github.com/cheat-engine/cheat-engine/blob/7.2/Cheat%20Engine/winsapi.pas)。
- Lua 来源及许可：[Lua 官方许可页](https://www.lua.org/license.html)。
- Microsoft Huihui 语音由 Windows 本机提供；本仓库没有分发语音引擎，附带 WAV 仅为本机生成的中文提示示例。
- Warcraft III 的游戏程序、地图和存档不随本仓库分发。游戏名称与商标归其权利人。

本仓库不把第三方原始代码或组件重新声明为由发布者独立创作，也不为其授予新的许可。

`work/adapter.lua`:

```lua
-- 1.29.2 port: retain the recovered form and lists; replace old Game.dll hooks.
local adapter, connected, busy, targetPid = nil, false, false, 0
local hotkeys, lastPress = {}, -1000
local voice = WAR3_TRAINER_VOICE -- Optional shared feedback in the voice build.
local title = WAR3_INTEGRATED_MODE and 'Warcraft III 通用cheat | 1.29.2.9231' or 'Warcraft III Legacy 1.29.2 - Test'

local function explain(result)
  return errors[result.error] or result.message or '操作未完成，请检查游戏状态。'
end

local function status(text)
  CETrainer.Caption = title .. ' | ' .. text
end

local function disconnect(announce)
  if adapter then pcall(adapter.close) end
  connected, targetPid = false, 0
  CETrainer.CEToggleBox1.Checked = false
  CETrainer.CEToggleBox1.Caption = '点击连接 1.29.2 游戏'
  if announce and voice then voice.say('修改器已断开') end
end

function CETrainer_CEToggleBox1Click(sender)
  if busy then return end
  if not CETrainer.CEToggleBox1.Checked then
    disconnect(true)
    status('已断开')
    return
  end
  if not adapter then
    disconnect()
    if voice then voice.say('修改器组件未能加载') end
    showMessage('适配组件未能加载，请完整重新解压测试版。')
    return
  end
  local ok, result = pcall(adapter.connect)
  if not ok or type(result) ~= 'table' or not result.ok then
    disconnect()
    local message = (type(result) == 'table' and explain(result)) or tostring(result)
    if voice then voice.say('游戏连接失败') end
    status('连接失败')
    showMessage(message)
    return
  end
  connected, targetPid = true, result.pid
  CETrainer.CEToggleBox1.Caption = '已连接：回游戏使用快捷键'
  status('已连接；落点为镜头中心')
  if voice then voice.say('修改器已连接') end
end

local function integerText(edit)
  local s = tostring(edit.Text)
  if not s:match('^%d+$') then return nil end
  local n = tonumber(s)
  if not n or n < 0 or n > 100000 then return nil end
  return n
end

local function action(op)
  -- Generic CE hotkeys are global; ignore them outside the connected game.
  if not connected or busy or targetPid == 0 or getForegroundProcess() ~= targetPid then return end
  local now = getTickCount()
  if now >= lastPress and now-lastPress < 350 then return end
  lastPress = now
  local a, b, c = 0, 0, 0
  if op == 2 then
    a = integerText(CETrainer.CEEdit1)
    b = integerText(CETrainer.CEEdit2)
    c = integerText(CETrainer.CEEdit3)
    if not a or not b or not c then
      if voice then voice.failure(104) end
      showMessage('力量、敏捷、智力请输入 0 到 100000 的整数。')
      return
    end
  end
  local unit = CETrainer.CEComboBox1.ItemIndex+1
  local item = CETrainer.CEComboBox2.ItemIndex+1
  local skill = CETrainer.CEComboBox3.ItemIndex+1
  if (op == 11 and (unit < 1 or unit > 814)) or
     (op == 12 and (item < 1 or item > 273)) or
     (op == 13 and (skill < 1 or skill > 778)) then
    if voice then voice.say('请先选择对应条目') end
    showMessage('请先在对应下拉框中选择单位、物品或技能。')
    return
  end
  busy = true
  local ok, result = pcall(adapter.request, op, a, b, c, unit, item, skill)
  busy = false
  if not ok or type(result) ~= 'table' then
    disconnect()
    if voice then voice.failure(116) end
    status('操作异常，已断开')
    showMessage(tostring(result))
    return
  end
  if not result.ok then
    if result.fatal then disconnect() end
    if voice then voice.failure(result.error) end
    status('操作未完成')
    showMessage(explain(result))
    return
  end
  CETrainer['CHEAT' .. (op-1)].setActive(true, 1000)
  local summary = '完成；处理 ' .. tostring(result.applied) .. ' 个目标'
  if op == 1 then summary = '英雄等级：' .. tostring(result.level) end
  if op == 8 or op == 11 then summary = '已在镜头中心新建单位' end
  if op == 10 then summary = '已请求瞬移至镜头中心；落点受地形影响' end
  if op == 12 then summary = '已在镜头中心创建物品' end
  if op == 14 then summary = '已处理 ' .. result.applied .. ' 项已有技能；等级受地图限制' end
  if op == 15 then summary = '已处理 ' .. result.applied .. ' 项科技；等级受地图限制' end
  if op == 16 then summary = '金木与食物上限已设置：' .. result.gold end
  if op == 17 then summary = '已开启全图可见；断开连接时关闭' end
  if op == 18 then summary = '已复活 ' .. result.applied .. ' 个英雄' end
  status(summary)
  if voice then voice.success(op,result) end
end

function AboutClick()
  showMessage('由用户提供的原修改器静态恢复并适配。\n' ..
    '仅支持指定目录的 Warcraft III 1.29.2.9231。\n' ..
    '复制为新建同类型单位；瞬移、创建、复活落点为镜头中心。\n' ..
    '换图或读档后请断开并重新连接。')
end

function CloseClick()
  disconnect()
  for _, hk in ipairs(hotkeys) do hk.destroy() end
  hotkeys = {}
  closeCE()
  return caFree
end

do
  local loadAdapter, loadError = package.loadlib(getCheatEngineDir() .. 'legacy_adapter.dll', 'luaopen_legacy_adapter')

/* Replaces the old Game.dll hooks with bounded native calls on the game thread.
 * The camera center is intentional: no unverified mouse-world address is used.
 */
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "adapter_core.h"
#include "rawcodes.h"
static float real_value(uint32_t bits){union{uint32_t i;float f;}v;v.i=bits;return v.f;}
static float unit_value(NativeFns* n,uint32_t u,int state){return real_value(n->GetUnitState(u,state));}
static int same_unit(NativeFns* n,uint32_t u,uint32_t type,uint32_t owner){
    return (uint32_t)n->GetUnitTypeId(u)==type && n->GetOwningPlayer(u)==owner;
}
const char* adapter_error_message(uint32_t e){
    switch(e){
    case E_OK:return "Completed; inspect applied and readback fields.";
    case E_PROTOCOL:return "Protocol identity or sequence mismatch.";
    case E_VERSION:return "Only the exact Warcraft III 1.29.2.9231 executable is supported.";
    case E_NOT_READY:return "Enter a loaded single-player map before activation.";
    case E_INPUT:return "Input outside the supported range.";
    case E_NO_UNIT:return "Select a unit in the game first.";
    case E_NOT_HERO:return "The selected unit is not a hero.";
    case E_BOUND:return "Enumeration limit exceeded; no request retry.";
    case E_READBACK:return "A native readback did not match; the request may have partly applied.";
    case E_NATIVE:return "A native call returned failure.";
    case E_WORLD:return "The map world changed; activate again after loading.";
    case E_FOREGROUND:return "The verified game window must be in the foreground.";
    case E_TIMEOUT:return "Request timed out; result is unknown. It will not be retried.";
    case E_CONNECTION:return "Game connection is unavailable.";
    case E_BUSY:return "A request is already pending.";
    case E_SIGNATURE:return "Game native signature mismatch.";
    case E_EXCEPTION:return "Native exception caught; close and reactivate after checking the game.";
    case E_NO_EFFECT:return "No applicable unit, ability, technology or dead hero was found.";
    default:return "Unknown adapter error.";
    }
}
int adapter_validate(const AdapterPacket* p){
    if(p->op>19)return E_INPUT;
    if(p->op==2 && (p->a<0 || p->a>100000 || p->b<0 || p->b>100000 || p->c<0 || p->c>100000))return E_INPUT;
    if(p->op==11 && (p->unit_index<1 || p->unit_index>814))return E_INPUT;
    if(p->op==12 && (p->item_index<1 || p->item_index>273))return E_INPUT;
    if(p->op==13 && (p->skill_index<1 || p->skill_index>778))return E_INPUT;
    return E_OK;
}
static int collect_selected(AdapterPacket* p,NativeFns* n,uint32_t player,uint32_t* type,uint32_t* owner){
    uint32_t group=n->CreateGroup(),u=0;
    if(!group)return E_NATIVE;
    n->GroupEnumUnitsSelected(group,player,0);
    while((u=n->FirstOfGroup(group))!=0){
        if(p->selected>=MAX_SELECTED){n->DestroyGroup(group);return E_BOUND;}
        if(!p->selected)p->unit=u;
        p->selected++;
        n->GroupRemoveUnit(group,u);
        if(n->FirstOfGroup(group)==u){n->DestroyGroup(group);return E_BOUND;}
    }
    n->DestroyGroup(group);
    if(p->unit){*type=(uint32_t)n->GetUnitTypeId(p->unit);*owner=n->GetOwningPlayer(p->unit);if(!*type || !*owner)return E_NO_UNIT;}
    return E_OK;
}
int adapter_execute(AdapterPacket* p,NativeFns* n,AdapterGameState* state){
    uint32_t player,u,type=0,owner=0;int error=adapter_validate(p),hero=0;
    if(error)return error;
    if(p->expected_world && p->world!=p->expected_world){p->fatal=1;return E_WORLD;}
    player=n->GetLocalPlayer();if(!player || n->GetPlayerId(player)<0 || n->GetPlayerId(player)>=28)return E_NOT_READY;
    if(state->world!=p->world || state->local_player!=player){
        /* A destroyed map owns and releases its old handles. Never call into
         * the new map using an old fog handle. */
        state->world=p->world;state->local_player=player;state->fog=0;
    }
    if(p->op==19){
        if(state->fog){n->FogModifierStop(state->fog);n->DestroyFogModifier(state->fog);state->fog=0;p->applied=1;}
        return E_OK;
    }
    p->x=real_value(n->GetCameraTargetPositionX());p->y=real_value(n->GetCameraTargetPositionY());
    if(!isfinite(p->x) || !isfinite(p->y) || fabsf(p->x)>1000000 || fabsf(p->y)>1000000)return E_NOT_READY;
    error=collect_selected(p,n,player,&type,&owner);if(error)return error;
    u=p->unit;
    p->gold=n->GetPlayerState(player,1);p->lumber=n->GetPlayerState(player,2);p->food=n->GetPlayerState(player,4);
    if(u){hero=n->IsUnitType(u,0);if(hero)p->level=n->GetHeroLevel(u);}
    if(p->op==0)return E_OK;
    if((p->op<=10 || p->op==13 || p->op==14) && !u)return E_NO_UNIT;
    if(p->op<=3 && !hero)return E_NOT_HERO;
    if(u && !same_unit(n,u,type,owner))return E_WORLD;
    switch(p->op){
    case 1:
        n->SetHeroLevel(u,1000,1);p->level=n->GetHeroLevel(u);p->applied=1;
        snprintf(p->message,sizeof(p->message),"Hero level readback: %u (requested 1000; map may clamp).",p->level);
        return p->level?E_OK:E_READBACK;
    case 2:
        n->SetHeroStr(u,p->a,1);if(!same_unit(n,u,type,owner))return E_WORLD;
        n->SetHeroAgi(u,p->b,1);if(!same_unit(n,u,type,owner))return E_WORLD;
        n->SetHeroInt(u,p->c,1);p->applied=1;
        return n->GetHeroStr(u,0)==p->a && n->GetHeroAgi(u,0)==p->b && n->GetHeroInt(u,0)==p->c?E_OK:E_READBACK;
    case 3:{int before=n->GetHeroSkillPoints(u);if(before<0 || before>=100000)return E_INPUT;
        if(!n->UnitModifySkillPoints(u,1))return E_NATIVE;p->applied=1;
        return n->GetHeroSkillPoints(u)==before+1?E_OK:E_READBACK;}
    case 4:case 5:
        n->SetUnitInvulnerable(u,p->op==4);p->applied=1;
        strcpy(p->message,"Invulnerability native issued once; combat effect requires in-game validation.");return E_OK;
    case 6:
        n->UnitResetCooldown(u);p->applied=1;
        strcpy(p->message,"Cooldown reset native issued once; cast behavior requires in-game validation.");return E_OK;
    case 7:{float hp=unit_value(n,u,1),mp=unit_value(n,u,3),life=unit_value(n,u,0);
        if(!isfinite(hp)||!isfinite(mp)||!isfinite(life)||hp<=0||mp<0||life<=0.405f)return E_NO_EFFECT;
        n->SetUnitState(u,0,&hp);if(!same_unit(n,u,type,owner))return E_WORLD;
        if(mp>0)n->SetUnitState(u,2,&mp);p->applied=1;
        return fabsf(unit_value(n,u,0)-hp)<=0.1f && (mp==0||fabsf(unit_value(n,u,2)-mp)<=0.1f)?E_OK:E_READBACK;}
    case 8:case 11:{float facing=270.0f;uint32_t raw=p->op==8?type:UNIT_IDS[p->unit_index-1];
        uint32_t created=n->CreateUnit(player,(int)raw,&p->x,&p->y,&facing);
        if(!created)return E_NATIVE;p->applied=1;
        strcpy(p->message,"Created one unit of the chosen type at the camera center; equipment and hero state are not copied.");
        return (uint32_t)n->GetUnitTypeId(created)==raw?E_OK:E_READBACK;}
    case 9:n->RemoveUnit(u);p->applied=1;return n->GetUnitTypeId(u)==0?E_OK:E_READBACK;
    case 10:n->SetUnitPosition(u,&p->x,&p->y);p->applied=1;
        strcpy(p->message,"Position native issued once at camera center; pathing can adjust the final location.");return E_OK;
    case 12:{uint32_t item=n->CreateItem((int)ITEM_IDS[p->item_index-1],&p->x,&p->y);
        if(!item)return E_NATIVE;p->applied=1;return E_OK;}
    case 13:{int id=(int)SKILL_IDS[p->skill_index-1];
        if(n->GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,id)>0)return E_NO_EFFECT;
        if(!n->UnitAddAbility(u,id))return E_NATIVE;p->applied=1;
        return n->GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,id)>0?E_OK:E_READBACK;}
    case 14:
        for(unsigned i=0;i<778;i++){int id=(int)SKILL_IDS[i];if(n->GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,id)>0){
            if(!same_unit(n,u,type,owner))return E_WORLD;
            n->SetUnitAbilityLevel(u,id,1000);if(n->GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,id)>0)p->applied++;
        }}
        strcpy(p->message,"Existing listed abilities requested at level 1000; applied counts positive readbacks, map maximums may clamp.");
        return p->applied?E_OK:E_NO_EFFECT;
    case 15:
        for(unsigned i=0;i<89;i++){int id=(int)TECH_IDS[i];n->SetPlayerTechResearched(player,id,1000);
            if(n->GetPlayerTechCount(player,id,1)>0)p->applied++;}
        strcpy(p->message,"Listed technologies requested at level 1000; applied counts positive research readbacks.");
        return p->applied?E_OK:E_NO_EFFECT;
    case 16:
        n->SetPlayerState(player,1,0x1000000);n->SetPlayerState(player,2,0x1000000);n->SetPlayerState(player,4,0x1000000);
        p->gold=n->GetPlayerState(player,1);p->lumber=n->GetPlayerState(player,2);p->food=n->GetPlayerState(player,4);p->applied=3;
        return p->gold==0x1000000 && p->lumber==0x1000000 && p->food==0x1000000?E_OK:E_READBACK;
    case 17:
        if(!state->fog){uint32_t rect=n->GetWorldBounds();if(!rect)return E_NATIVE;
            state->fog=n->CreateFogModifierRect(player,4,rect,1,0);n->RemoveRect(rect);if(!state->fog)return E_NATIVE;}
        n->FogModifierStart(state->fog);p->applied=1;
        strcpy(p->message,"Full-map fog modifier started; deactivation stops and destroys this adapter's modifier.");return E_OK;
    case 18:{uint32_t list[MAX_REVIVE],count=0,group=n->CreateGroup(),next;
        if(!group)return E_NATIVE;n->GroupEnumUnitsOfPlayer(group,player,0);
        while((next=n->FirstOfGroup(group))!=0){
            if(count>=MAX_REVIVE){n->DestroyGroup(group);return E_BOUND;}
            list[count++]=next;n->GroupRemoveUnit(group,next);
            if(n->FirstOfGroup(group)==next){n->DestroyGroup(group);return E_BOUND;}
        }
        n->DestroyGroup(group);
        for(uint32_t i=0;i<count;i++)if(n->GetUnitTypeId(list[i]) && n->GetOwningPlayer(list[i])==player && n->IsUnitType(list[i],0) && n->IsUnitType(list[i],1)){
            if(n->ReviveHero(list[i],&p->x,&p->y,1))p->applied++;
        }
        return p->applied?E_OK:E_NO_EFFECT;}
    default:return E_INPUT;
    }
}

"""Build x86 adapter and run isolated tests; never starts the supplied EXE/game."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys
import pefile
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CC=Path(os.environ.get('WAR3_CC', r'D:\Dev-Cpp\MinGW64\bin\gcc.exe'))
LUA=Path(os.environ.get('WAR3_LUA32', r'D:\Cheat Engine 7.6\lua53-32.dll'))
if not LUA.exists(): LUA=ROOT.parent/'unpacked'/'lua53-32.dll'
def run(*args):
    r=subprocess.run([str(x) for x in args],cwd=ROOT,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
    print(r.stdout,end='')
    if r.stderr:print(r.stderr,file=sys.stderr,end='')
    return r.stdout
run(sys.executable,ROOT/'extract_profile.py')
FLAGS=['-m32','-std=gnu99','-O1','-Wall','-Wextra','-fno-omit-frame-pointer','-static-libgcc']

```py
"""Extract exact JASS registrations from the immutable local 1.29.2 PE."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re, struct
import pefile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
TARGET = Path(r'E:\Games\Warcraft III (Legacy)\Warcraft III.exe')
SHA256 = '3f2ed0120d80578bf07e4423296dade1adfb959d59a2d20a7584224559570eed'
NAMES = '''GetLocalPlayer GetPlayerId GetPlayerState SetPlayerState GetUnitTypeId
GetOwningPlayer IsUnitType CreateGroup DestroyGroup GroupEnumUnitsSelected
GroupEnumUnitsOfPlayer FirstOfGroup GroupRemoveUnit GetHeroLevel SetHeroLevel
GetHeroStr GetHeroAgi GetHeroInt SetHeroStr SetHeroAgi SetHeroInt
GetHeroSkillPoints UnitModifySkillPoints SetUnitInvulnerable UnitResetCooldown
GetUnitState SetUnitState CreateUnit RemoveUnit SetUnitPosition CreateItem
UnitAddAbility GetUnitAbilityLevel SetUnitAbilityLevel SetPlayerTechResearched
GetPlayerTechCount GetCameraTargetPositionX GetCameraTargetPositionY
GetWorldBounds CreateFogModifierRect FogModifierStart FogModifierStop
DestroyFogModifier RemoveRect ReviveHero'''.split()

def split_types(sig):
    result = []
    while sig:
        if sig[0] == 'H':
            end = sig.index(';') + 1
        else:
            end = 1
        result.append(sig[:end]); sig = sig[end:]
    return result

def ctype(t, result=False):
    if t.startswith('H'): return 'uint32_t'
    return {'V':'void','I':'int','B':'unsigned char' if result else 'int',
            'R':'uint32_t' if result else 'float*'}[t]

def main():
    raw = TARGET.read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == SHA256
    pe = pefile.PE(data=raw); base = pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.ImageBase
    assert pe.FILE_HEADER.Machine == 0x14c
    def string(va):
        return pe.get_data(va-base, 200).split(b'\0')[0].decode('ascii')
    entries = {}
    for name in NAMES:
        start = 0; candidates = []
        while (at := raw.find(name.encode()+b'\0', start)) >= 0:
            start = at+1
            needle = struct.pack('<I', base+pe.get_rva_from_offset(at)); pos = 0
            while (ref := raw.find(needle,pos)) >= 0:
                pos = ref+1
                if (raw[ref-6:ref-5],raw[ref-1:ref],raw[ref+4:ref+5],raw[ref+9:ref+10]) != (b'\x68',b'\x68',b'\x68',b'\xe8'):
                    continue
                sig, fn = struct.unpack_from('<I',raw,ref-5)[0],struct.unpack_from('<I',raw,ref+5)[0]
                try: signature = string(sig)
                except (ValueError,UnicodeError): continue
                if signature.startswith('('): candidates.append((ref,signature,fn))
        assert candidates, name
        ref, signature, fn = min(candidates); rva = fn-base
        # This build also registers an alternate native family later in .text.
        # Select the original JASS registration family at the lowest file offset,
        # matching the existing observed 1.29.2 native calling convention.
        reloc = [i.rva-rva for b in pe.DIRECTORY_ENTRY_BASERELOC for i in b.entries
                 if i.type == 3 and rva <= i.rva < rva+32]
        entries[name] = dict(rva=rva,signature=signature,code=pe.get_data(rva,36).hex(),relocations=reloc,
                             registration_file_offset=ref-6,candidates=candidates)
    profile = dict(sha256=SHA256,version='1.29.2.9231',timestamp=pe.FILE_HEADER.TimeDateStamp,
                   image_size=pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.SizeOfImage,image_base=base,
                   world_rva=0xd3b6f4,world_vtable_rva=0xa6e73c,natives=entries)
    (ROOT/'profile.json').write_text(json.dumps(profile,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
    h = ['/* Generated from hash-locked local PE; do not hand-edit addresses. */',
         '#ifndef ADAPTER_PROFILE_H','#define ADAPTER_PROFILE_H','#include <stdint.h>',
         f'#define PROFILE_TIMESTAMP {profile["timestamp"]}u',f'#define PROFILE_SIZE {profile["image_size"]}u',
         f'#define PROFILE_BASE {base}u','#define WORLD_RVA 0xd3b6f4u','#define WORLD_VTABLE_RVA 0xa6e73cu']
    for i,name in enumerate(entries): h.append(f'#define FN_{name} {i}')
    h += [f'#define FN_COUNT {len(entries)}','typedef struct {uint32_t rva;unsigned char code[36],reloc[8];uint32_t reloc_count;} NativeProfile;',
          'static const NativeProfile NATIVE_PROFILE[FN_COUNT]={']
    for e in entries.values():
        code=','.join('0x'+e['code'][i:i+2] for i in range(0,72,2))
        h.append('{'+str(e['rva'])+',{'+code+'},{'+','.join(map(str,e['relocations'] or [0]))+'},'+str(len(e['relocations']))+'},')
    h += ['};','typedef struct {']
    for name,e in entries.items():
        args,ret=e['signature'][1:].split(')')
        h.append(f'    {ctype(ret,True)} (__cdecl *{name})({",".join(ctype(t) for t in split_types(args)) or "void"});')
    h += ['} NativeFns;','#define BIND_ALL(n,addresses) do { \\']
    for name in entries: h.append(f'    (n).{name}=(void*)(addresses)[FN_{name}]; \\')
    h += ['} while(0)','#endif']
    (ROOT/'profile_native.h').write_text('\n'.join(h)+'\n',encoding='utf8')
    codes=json.loads((ROOT.parent/'recovery_verified'/'rawcodes.json').read_text('utf8'))
    h=['/* Original trainer tables, decoded as little-endian rawcodes. */','#include <stdint.h>']
    for record,name,count in [('164','TECH_IDS',89),('165','SKILL_IDS',778),('175','ITEM_IDS',273),('176','UNIT_IDS',814)]:
        assert len(codes[record])==count
        vals=[int.from_bytes(s.encode('ascii'),'big') for s in codes[record]]
        h.append(f'static const uint32_t {name}[{count}]={{'+','.join(f'0x{x:08x}u' for x in vals)+'};')
    (ROOT/'rawcodes.h').write_text('\n'.join(h)+'\n',encoding='utf8')
    print(f'Verified {len(entries)} exact native registrations, 1954 original rawcodes')

if __name__ == '__main__': main()

`work/adapter_native/guard32.h`:

```h
/* Isolated x86 SEH frame. The build fixture must pass before use in a game.
 * Do not let an invalid native pointer unwind through the game's window loop.
 */
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdint.h>
typedef struct { uint32_t previous,handler,esp,ebp,ebx,esi,edi,resume; } GuardFrame;
EXCEPTION_DISPOSITION __cdecl guard_handler(EXCEPTION_RECORD* e,void* frame,CONTEXT* c,void* dispatcher) {
    GuardFrame* f=(GuardFrame*)frame;
    (void)dispatcher;
    if(e->ExceptionCode!=EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION && e->ExceptionCode!=EXCEPTION_INT_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO) return ExceptionContinueSearch;
    if(e->ExceptionFlags&EXCEPTION_NONCONTINUABLE)return ExceptionContinueSearch;
    c->Eip=f->resume;c->Esp=f->esp;c->Ebp=f->ebp;c->Ebx=f->ebx;c->Esi=f->esi;c->Edi=f->edi;c->Eax=e->ExceptionCode;
    return ExceptionContinueExecution;
}
/* GCC 4.9 does not support x86 naked functions. A top-level assembler symbol
 * prevents an implicit C prologue from corrupting the explicit SEH frame. */
uint32_t __cdecl guard_call(uint32_t (__cdecl *fn)(void*),void* arg,uint32_t* fault);
__asm__(
        ".text\n.globl _guard_call\n_guard_call:\n"
        "pushl %ebp\nmovl %esp,%ebp\npushl %ebx\npushl %esi\npushl %edi\nsubl $32,%esp\n"
        "movl %fs:0,%eax\nmovl %eax,0(%esp)\nmovl $_guard_handler,4(%esp)\n"
        "movl %esp,8(%esp)\nmovl %ebp,12(%esp)\nmovl %ebx,16(%esp)\nmovl %esi,20(%esp)\nmovl %edi,24(%esp)\n"
        "movl $1f,28(%esp)\nmovl %esp,%fs:0\npushl 12(%ebp)\ncall *8(%ebp)\naddl $4,%esp\nxorl %edx,%edx\njmp 2f\n"
        "1: movl %eax,%edx\nxorl %eax,%eax\n"
        "2: movl 0(%esp),%ecx\nmovl %ecx,%fs:0\nmovl 16(%ebp),%ecx\nmovl %edx,(%ecx)\n"
        "addl $32,%esp\npopl %edi\npopl %esi\npopl %ebx\npopl %ebp\nret\n");

```

    if(fault!=0xc0000005 || r!=0)return 1;

    p->pid=host_pid;p->host_pid=GetCurrentProcessId();p->nonce=host_nonce;p->nonce2=host_nonce2;

static void failure(AdapterPacket* p,uint32_t error,int fatal){

static int bind_native(uintptr_t base){
    IMAGE_DOS_HEADER* dos=(void*)base;IMAGE_NT_HEADERS32* pe=(void*)(base+dos->e_lfanew);
    if(dos->e_magic!=IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE || dos->e_lfanew<64 || dos->e_lfanew>4096 || pe->Signature!=IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE || pe->FileHeader.Machine!=IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_I386 || pe->OptionalHeader.Magic!=IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR32_MAGIC || pe->FileHeader.TimeDateStamp!=PROFILE_TIMESTAMP || pe->OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage!=PROFILE_SIZE)return E_VERSION;
    uintptr_t addresses[FN_COUNT];uint32_t shift=(uint32_t)base-PROFILE_BASE;
    for(unsigned i=0;i<FN_COUNT;i++){
        const NativeProfile* spec=&NATIVE_PROFILE[i];unsigned char expected[36];memcpy(expected,spec->code,36);
        for(unsigned j=0;j<spec->reloc_count;j++){uint32_t v;memcpy(&v,expected+spec->reloc[j],4);v+=shift;memcpy(expected+spec->reloc[j],&v,4);}
        if(memcmp((void*)(base+spec->rva),expected,32))return E_SIGNATURE;

    }
    BIND_ALL(natives,addresses);return E_OK;
}
static uint32_t __cdecl execute_guarded(void* arg){
    AdapterPacket* p=arg;uintptr_t base=(uintptr_t)GetModuleHandleW(NULL);int error=bind_native(base);
    if(error){p->fatal=1;return error;}
    uint32_t world=*(uint32_t*)(base+WORLD_RVA);
    if(!world || *(uint32_t*)world!=(uint32_t)base+WORLD_VTABLE_RVA)return E_NOT_READY;
    p->world=world;
    if(p->op && p->op!=19){DWORD fg_pid=0;GetWindowThreadProcessId(GetForegroundWindow(),&fg_pid);if(fg_pid!=GetCurrentProcessId())return E_FOREGROUND;}
    error=adapter_execute(p,&natives,&game_state);
    if(*(uint32_t*)(base+WORLD_RVA)!=world){p->fatal=1;return E_WORLD;}
    return error;
}
static int open_game_mapping(uint32_t nonce){
    if(game_shared && game_nonce==nonce)return 1;
    if(game_shared){UnmapViewOfFile(game_shared);CloseHandle(game_mapping);game_shared=0;game_mapping=0;}
    wchar_t name[128];swprintf(name,128,L"Local\\War3CE129Adapter-%lu-%08lx",GetCurrentProcessId(),(unsigned long)nonce);
    game_mapping=OpenFileMappingW(FILE_MAP_ALL_ACCESS,FALSE,name);if(!game_mapping)return 0;
    game_shared=MapViewOfFile(game_mapping,FILE_MAP_ALL_ACCESS,0,0,sizeof(AdapterPacket));
    if(!game_shared){CloseHandle(game_mapping);game_mapping=0;return 0;}
    if(game_shared->magic!=ADAPTER_MAGIC || game_shared->version!=ADAPTER_VERSION || game_shared->bytes!=sizeof(AdapterPacket) || game_shared->pid!=GetCurrentProcessId() || game_shared->nonce!=nonce || !game_shared->nonce2 || !game_shared->host_pid){
        UnmapViewOfFile(game_shared);CloseHandle(game_mapping);game_shared=0;game_mapping=0;return 0;
    }
    game_nonce=nonce;game_nonce2=game_shared->nonce2;game_poisoned=0;return 1;
}
__declspec(dllexport) LRESULT CALLBACK LegacyAdapterHook(int code,WPARAM w,LPARAM l){
    if(!request_message)request_message=RegisterWindowMessageW(L"War3CE129Adapter.Request.v1");
    if(code==HC_ACTION && w==PM_REMOVE){MSG* msg=(MSG*)l;
        if(msg->message==request_message && msg->wParam && open_game_mapping((uint32_t)msg->wParam)){
            uint32_t seq=(uint32_t)msg->lParam;
            if(seq && game_shared->seq==seq && game_shared->ack!=seq && InterlockedCompareExchange(&game_shared->status,2,1)==1){
                AdapterPacket local;memcpy(&local,game_shared,sizeof(local));uint32_t error=E_PROTOCOL,fault=0;
                if(local.magic==ADAPTER_MAGIC && local.version==ADAPTER_VERSION && local.bytes==sizeof(local) && local.pid==GetCurrentProcessId() && local.nonce==game_nonce && local.nonce2==game_nonce2 && local.seq==seq){
                    error=game_poisoned?E_EXCEPTION:guard_call(execute_guarded,&local,&fault);
                    if(fault){error=E_EXCEPTION;local.fatal=1;game_poisoned=1;snprintf(local.message,sizeof(local.message),"Native exception 0x%08lx; result may be partial. No retry.",(unsigned long)fault);}
                }
                local.error=error;if(error && !local.message[0])strncpy(local.message,adapter_error_message(error),sizeof(local.message)-1);
                if(error==E_WORLD || error==E_SIGNATURE || error==E_VERSION)local.fatal=1;
                local.status=error?4:3;local.ack=0;
                memcpy(game_shared,&local,sizeof(local));__sync_synchronize();InterlockedExchange((LONG*)&game_shared->ack,(LONG)seq);
            }
            msg->message=WM_NULL;msg->wParam=0;msg->lParam=0;
        }
    }
    return CallNextHookEx(NULL,code,w,l);
}
static void host_cleanup(void){
    if(host_hook){UnhookWindowsHookEx(host_hook);host_hook=0;}
    if(host_shared){UnmapViewOfFile(host_shared);host_shared=0;}
    if(host_mapping){CloseHandle(host_mapping);host_mapping=0;}
    if(host_process){CloseHandle(host_process);host_process=0;}
    if(host_file){CloseHandle(host_file);host_file=0;}
    if(host_mutex){CloseHandle(host_mutex);host_mutex=0;}
    host_pid=host_tid=host_world=0;host_poisoned=0;
}
static int hash_target(HANDLE f){
    HCRYPTPROV provider=0;HCRYPTHASH hash=0;unsigned char bytes[65536],digest[32];DWORD count,size=32;char hex[65];int ok=0;
    if(!CryptAcquireContextW(&provider,NULL,NULL,PROV_RSA_AES,CRYPT_VERIFYCONTEXT))goto done;
    if(!CryptCreateHash(provider,CALG_SHA_256,0,0,&hash))goto done;
    SetFilePointer(f,0,NULL,FILE_BEGIN);
    for(;;){if(!ReadFile(f,bytes,sizeof(bytes),&count,NULL))goto done;if(!count)break;if(!CryptHashData(hash,bytes,count,0))goto done;}
    if(!CryptGetHashParam(hash,HP_HASHVAL,digest,&size,0)||size!=32)goto done;
    for(unsigned i=0;i<32;i++)sprintf(hex+i*2,"%02x",digest[i]);hex[64]=0;ok=!strcmp(hex,TARGET_SHA);
done:if(hash)CryptDestroyHash(hash);if(provider)CryptReleaseContext(provider,0);return ok;
}
typedef struct {DWORD pid,tid;uint64_t area;} WindowChoice;
static BOOL CALLBACK choose_window(HWND window,LPARAM arg){
    WindowChoice* c=(WindowChoice*)arg;DWORD pid=0;DWORD tid=GetWindowThreadProcessId(window,&pid);RECT r;
    if(pid==c->pid && IsWindowVisible(window) && !GetWindow(window,GW_OWNER) && GetClientRect(window,&r)){
        uint64_t area=(uint64_t)(r.right-r.left)*(uint64_t)(r.bottom-r.top);if(area>c->area){c->tid=tid;c->area=area;}
    }
    return TRUE;
}
static int discover_target(void){
    HANDLE snapshot=CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS,0);PROCESSENTRY32W item={0};item.dwSize=sizeof(item);DWORD found=0;
    if(snapshot==INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)return E_CONNECTION;
    if(Process32FirstW(snapshot,&item))do{if(!_wcsicmp(item.szExeFile,L"Warcraft III.exe")){
        HANDLE p=OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION|PROCESS_VM_READ|SYNCHRONIZE,FALSE,item.th32ProcessID);
        wchar_t path[32768];DWORD chars=32768;
        if(p && QueryFullProcessImageNameW(p,0,path,&chars) && !_wcsicmp(path,TARGET_PATH)){
            if(found){CloseHandle(p);CloseHandle(snapshot);return E_CONNECTION;}
            found=item.th32ProcessID;host_process=p;
        }else if(p)CloseHandle(p);
    }}while(Process32NextW(snapshot,&item));CloseHandle(snapshot);
    if(!found)return E_CONNECTION;host_pid=found;
    host_file=CreateFileW(TARGET_PATH,GENERIC_READ,FILE_SHARE_READ,NULL,OPEN_EXISTING,FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL,NULL);
    if(host_file==INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE){host_file=0;return E_VERSION;}
    if(!hash_target(host_file))return E_VERSION;
    snapshot=CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPMODULE,found);MODULEENTRY32W module={0};module.dwSize=sizeof(module);
    if(snapshot==INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)return E_CONNECTION;
    int got_module=Module32FirstW(snapshot,&module);CloseHandle(snapshot);if(!got_module || _wcsicmp(module.szExePath,TARGET_PATH))return E_VERSION;
    IMAGE_DOS_HEADER dos;IMAGE_NT_HEADERS32 pe;SIZE_T got=0;
    if(!ReadProcessMemory(host_process,module.modBaseAddr,&dos,sizeof(dos),&got) || got!=sizeof(dos) || dos.e_magic!=IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE || dos.e_lfanew<64 || dos.e_lfanew>4096)return E_VERSION;
    if(!ReadProcessMemory(host_process,module.modBaseAddr+dos.e_lfanew,&pe,sizeof(pe),&got) || got!=sizeof(pe) || pe.Signature!=IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE || pe.FileHeader.Machine!=IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_I386 || pe.OptionalHeader.Magic!=IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR32_MAGIC || pe.FileHeader.TimeDateStamp!=PROFILE_TIMESTAMP || pe.OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage!=PROFILE_SIZE)return E_VERSION;
    WindowChoice choice={found,0,0};EnumWindows(choose_window,(LPARAM)&choice);if(!choice.tid)return E_CONNECTION;host_tid=choice.tid;
    wchar_t name[128];swprintf(name,128,L"Local\\War3CE129Adapter-Owner-%lu",found);host_mutex=CreateMutexW(NULL,FALSE,name);
    if(!host_mutex || GetLastError()==ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS)return E_BUSY;
    HCRYPTPROV crypto=0;uint32_t nonce[2];
    if(!CryptAcquireContextW(&crypto,NULL,NULL,PROV_RSA_AES,CRYPT_VERIFYCONTEXT))return E_CONNECTION;
    int random_ok=CryptGenRandom(crypto,sizeof(nonce),(BYTE*)nonce);CryptReleaseContext(crypto,0);
    if(!random_ok || !nonce[0] || !nonce[1])return E_CONNECTION;host_nonce=nonce[0];host_nonce2=nonce[1];
    swprintf(name,128,L"Local\\War3CE129Adapter-%lu-%08lx",found,(unsigned long)host_nonce);
    host_mapping=CreateFileMappingW(INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE,NULL,PAGE_READWRITE,0,sizeof(AdapterPacket),name);
    if(!host_mapping || GetLastError()==ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS)return E_CONNECTION;
    host_shared=MapViewOfFile(host_mapping,FILE_MAP_ALL_ACCESS,0,0,sizeof(AdapterPacket));if(!host_shared)return E_CONNECTION;
    init_packet(host_shared);
    if(!request_message)request_message=RegisterWindowMessageW(L"War3CE129Adapter.Request.v1");
    host_hook=SetWindowsHookExW(WH_GETMESSAGE,LegacyAdapterHook,self_module,host_tid);
    return host_hook?E_OK:E_CONNECTION;
}
static int transact(AdapterPacket* p){
    if(!host_hook || !host_shared || !host_process || WaitForSingleObject(host_process,0)!=WAIT_TIMEOUT || host_poisoned){failure(p,E_CONNECTION,1);return E_CONNECTION;}
    if(p->op && p->op!=19){DWORD foreground=0;GetWindowThreadProcessId(GetForegroundWindow(),&foreground);if(foreground!=host_pid){failure(p,E_FOREGROUND,0);return E_FOREGROUND;}}
    if(++host_sequence==0)++host_sequence;p->seq=host_sequence;p->expected_world=host_world;p->status=1;
    memcpy(host_shared,p,sizeof(*p));__sync_synchronize();
    if(!PostThreadMessageW(host_tid,request_message,host_nonce,(LPARAM)host_sequence)){failure(p,E_CONNECTION,1);host_poisoned=1;return E_CONNECTION;}
    DWORD start=GetTickCount();
    while((uint32_t)InterlockedCompareExchange((LONG*)&host_shared->ack,0,0)!=host_sequence){
        if(WaitForSingleObject(host_process,0)!=WAIT_TIMEOUT){failure(p,E_CONNECTION,1);host_poisoned=1;return E_CONNECTION;}
        if(GetTickCount()-start>=4000){
            /* Cancel only a not-yet-claimed request. A running native call is
             * never replayed; a timeout therefore means unknown completion. */
            InterlockedCompareExchange(&host_shared->status,5,1);failure(p,E_TIMEOUT,1);host_poisoned=1;return E_TIMEOUT;
        }
        Sleep(5);
    }
    __sync_synchronize();memcpy(p,host_shared,sizeof(*p));
    if(p->magic!=ADAPTER_MAGIC || p->version!=ADAPTER_VERSION || p->bytes!=sizeof(*p) || p->pid!=host_pid || p->nonce!=host_nonce || p->nonce2!=host_nonce2 || p->seq!=host_sequence || p->ack!=host_sequence){failure(p,E_PROTOCOL,1);host_poisoned=1;return E_PROTOCOL;}
    if(p->fatal)host_poisoned=1;if(!host_world && !p->error)host_world=p->world;
    return p->error;
}

/* Only this small dynamic Lua ABI is needed. In the game process these
 * pointers remain NULL and Lua is never loaded. */
typedef struct lua_State lua_State;
typedef long long lua_Integer;

static int bind_lua(void){
    HMODULE lua=GetModuleHandleW(L"lua53-32.dll");if(!lua)return 0;
    #define LUA(name) do{l_##name=(void*)GetProcAddress(lua,"lua_"#name);if(!l_##name)return 0;}while(0)
    LUA(gettop);LUA(type);LUA(tointegerx);LUA(createtable);LUA(pushinteger);LUA(pushnumber);LUA(pushboolean);LUA(pushstring);LUA(setfield);LUA(pushcclosure);
    #undef LUA
    return 1;
}
static void integer_field(lua_State* L,const char* key,lua_Integer value){l_pushinteger(L,value);l_setfield(L,-2,key);}
static int result_table(lua_State* L,AdapterPacket* p){
    l_createtable(L,0,18);l_pushboolean(L,p->error==0);l_setfield(L,-2,"ok");
    l_pushboolean(L,p->fatal!=0);l_setfield(L,-2,"fatal");
    integer_field(L,"error",p->error);integer_field(L,"pid",p->pid);integer_field(L,"applied",p->applied);
    integer_field(L,"selected",p->selected);integer_field(L,"unit",p->unit);integer_field(L,"level",p->level);
    integer_field(L,"gold",p->gold);integer_field(L,"lumber",p->lumber);integer_field(L,"food",p->food);
    l_pushnumber(L,p->x);l_setfield(L,-2,"x");l_pushnumber(L,p->y);l_setfield(L,-2,"y");
    l_pushstring(L,p->message[0]?p->message:adapter_error_message(p->error));l_setfield(L,-2,"message");return 1;
}
static int __cdecl lua_connect(lua_State* L){
    AdapterPacket p;memset(&p,0,sizeof(p));
    if(InterlockedCompareExchange(&host_busy,1,0)){failure(&p,E_BUSY,0);return result_table(L,&p);}
    if(l_gettop(L)!=0){failure(&p,E_INPUT,0);goto done;}
    if(host_hook){init_packet(&p);p.op=19;if(!host_poisoned)transact(&p);host_cleanup();}
    int error=discover_target();init_packet(&p);
    if(error){failure(&p,error,1);host_cleanup();}
    else if(transact(&p)){host_cleanup();}
done:InterlockedExchange(&host_busy,0);return result_table(L,&p);
}
static int __cdecl lua_request(lua_State* L){
    AdapterPacket p;init_packet(&p);
    if(InterlockedCompareExchange(&host_busy,1,0)){failure(&p,E_BUSY,0);return result_table(L,&p);}
    if(l_gettop(L)!=7){failure(&p,E_INPUT,0);goto done;}
    int32_t values[7];
    for(int i=0;i<7;i++){int valid=0;lua_Integer value=l_tointegerx(L,i+1,&valid);
        if(l_type(L,i+1)!=3 || !valid || value<INT32_MIN || value>INT32_MAX){failure(&p,E_INPUT,0);goto done;}values[i]=(int32_t)value;}
    p.op=(uint32_t)values[0];p.a=values[1];p.b=values[2];p.c=values[3];p.unit_index=values[4];p.item_index=values[5];p.skill_index=values[6];
    if(p.op>18){failure(&p,E_INPUT,0);goto done;}
    int error=adapter_validate(&p);if(error){failure(&p,error,0);goto done;}
    transact(&p);
done:InterlockedExchange(&host_busy,0);return result_table(L,&p);
}
static int __cdecl lua_close(lua_State* L){
    AdapterPacket p;init_packet(&p);
    if(InterlockedCompareExchange(&host_busy,1,0)){failure(&p,E_BUSY,0);return result_table(L,&p);}
    p.op=19;
    if(host_hook && !host_poisoned)transact(&p);
    else if(host_poisoned)failure(&p,E_CONNECTION,1);
    host_cleanup();InterlockedExchange(&host_busy,0);return result_table(L,&p);
}
__declspec(dllexport) int __cdecl luaopen_legacy_adapter(lua_State* L){
    if(!bind_lua())return 0;l_createtable(L,0,3);
    l_pushcclosure(L,lua_connect,0);l_setfield(L,-2,"connect");
    l_pushcclosure(L,lua_request,0);l_setfield(L,-2,"request");
    l_pushcclosure(L,lua_close,0);l_setfield(L,-2,"close");return 1;
}
BOOL WINAPI DllMain(HINSTANCE instance,DWORD reason,LPVOID reserved){
    (void)reserved;
    if(reason==DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH){self_module=instance;DisableThreadLibraryCalls(instance);}
    if(reason==DLL_PROCESS_DETACH){
        /* No native calls or waits under the loader lock. Lua close performs
         * fog cleanup and unhooking on the game thread before normal teardown.
         * On process termination Windows removes thread hooks itself. */
        if(host_shared)UnmapViewOfFile(host_shared);if(host_mapping)CloseHandle(host_mapping);
        if(host_process)CloseHandle(host_process);if(host_file)CloseHandle(host_file);if(host_mutex)CloseHandle(host_mutex);
        if(game_shared)UnmapViewOfFile(game_shared);if(game_mapping)CloseHandle(game_mapping);
    }
    return TRUE;
}

/* Usage: lua_runner.exe <absolute lua53-32.dll> <local script.lua>
 * Loads no game and installs no hook on its own. The explicit script chooses
 * the operations, permitting reproducible adapter tests without a CE UI.
 */
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
typedef struct lua_State lua_State;
typedef int (__cdecl *lua_KFunction)(lua_State*,int,intptr_t);
int wmain(int argc,wchar_t** argv){
    if(argc!=3){fprintf(stderr,"Usage: lua_runner.exe lua53-32.dll script.lua\n");return 2;}
    HMODULE m=LoadLibraryW(argv[1]);if(!m){fprintf(stderr,"LoadLibrary error %lu\n",GetLastError());return 3;}
    lua_State* (__cdecl *newstate)(void)=(void*)GetProcAddress(m,"luaL_newstate");
    void (__cdecl *openlibs)(lua_State*)=(void*)GetProcAddress(m,"luaL_openlibs");
    int (__cdecl *loadfile)(lua_State*,const char*,const char*)=(void*)GetProcAddress(m,"luaL_loadfilex");
    int (__cdecl *pcall)(lua_State*,int,int,int,intptr_t,lua_KFunction)=(void*)GetProcAddress(m,"lua_pcallk");
    const char* (__cdecl *tostring)(lua_State*,int,size_t*)=(void*)GetProcAddress(m,"lua_tolstring");
    void (__cdecl *close)(lua_State*)=(void*)GetProcAddress(m,"lua_close");
    if(!newstate||!openlibs||!loadfile||!pcall||!tostring||!close){fprintf(stderr,"Missing Lua 5.3 exports\n");return 4;}
    char path[32768];if(!WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8,0,argv[2],-1,path,sizeof(path),NULL,NULL))return 5;
    lua_State* L=newstate();if(!L)return 6;openlibs(L);
    int error=loadfile(L,path,NULL);if(!error)error=pcall(L,0,0,0,0,NULL);
    if(error){const char* text=tostring(L,-1,NULL);fprintf(stderr,"Lua error: %s\n",text?text:"unknown");}
    close(L);FreeLibrary(m);return error?7:0;
}

`work/build_adapter.py`:

```py
import os
"""Rebuild a separate trainer from the recovered form and authored adapter.

Only the ARCHIVE resource in the copied executable is replaced. The user's
original trainer and game installation are never changed by this script.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import ctypes as C
from ctypes import wintypes as W
import hashlib, json, shutil, struct, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, zlib
import pefile
from recover_trainer import EXPECTED, protect, unprotect

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOURCE = Path(os.environ.get('WAR3_TRAINER_SOURCE', Path.home()/'Downloads'/'Warcraft+Ⅲ+v1.20e1.24e1.27a通用cheat.EXE'))
OUT = ROOT.parent/'outputs'
DLL = ROOT/'adapter_native'/'legacy_adapter.dll'

def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def archive_members(blob):
    count = struct.unpack_from('<I', blob)[0]
    d = zlib.decompress(blob[4:], -15)
    pos, out = 0, []
    def read():
        nonlocal pos
        n = struct.unpack_from('<I', d, pos)[0]
        pos += 4
        b = d[pos:pos+n]
        pos += n
        assert len(b) == n
        return b
    for _ in range(count):
        name, folder, data = read().decode(), read().decode(), read()
        out.append((name, folder, data))
    assert pos == len(d)
    return out

def main():
    source = SOURCE.read_bytes()
    assert digest(source) == EXPECTED
    assert DLL.is_file(), 'Build native adapter first'
    dll_bytes = DLL.read_bytes()
    native_report = json.loads((DLL.parent/'BUILD_VERIFICATION.json').read_text('utf-8'))
    assert native_report['ok'] and digest(dll_bytes) == native_report['dll_sha256'], 'Native build is still changing or has not passed validation'
    assert pefile.PE(str(DLL), fast_load=True).FILE_HEADER.Machine == 0x14c
    tree = ET.parse(ROOT/'recovery_verified'/'original.CT').getroot()
    for child in list(tree):
        if child.tag != 'Forms': tree.remove(child)
    ET.SubElement(tree, 'CheatEntries')
    script = (ROOT/'adapter.lua').read_text('utf-8')
    ET.SubElement(tree, 'LuaScript').text = script
    assert 'Game.dll' not in script.replace('-- 1.29.2 port: retain the recovered form and lists; replace old Game.dll hooks.','')
    xml = ET.tostring(tree,encoding='utf-8',xml_declaration=True)
    trainer = protect(xml)
    assert unprotect(trainer) == xml
    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (ROOT/'adapted.CT').write_bytes(xml)
    members = []
    manifest = json.loads((ROOT/'recovery_verified'/'archive_manifest.json').read_text('utf-8'))
    for entry in manifest:
        name, folder = entry['name'], entry['folder']
        b = trainer if name == 'CET_TRAINER.CETRAINER' else (ROOT/'unpacked'/folder/name).read_bytes()
        if name != 'CET_TRAINER.CETRAINER': assert digest(b) == entry['sha256']
        members.append((name,folder,b))
    members.append(('legacy_adapter.dll','',dll_bytes))
    payload = bytearray()
    for name,folder,b in members:
        for value in (name.encode(),folder.encode(),b):
            payload.extend(struct.pack('<I',len(value)))
            payload.extend(value)
    compressor = zlib.compressobj(9,zlib.DEFLATED,-15)
    archive = struct.pack('<I',len(members))+compressor.compress(payload)+compressor.flush()
    assert archive_members(archive) == members
    exe = OUT/'War3_Legacy_1.29.2_Cheat_REA_Test.exe'
    shutil.copyfile(SOURCE,exe)
    kernel = C.WinDLL('kernel32',use_last_error=True)
    kernel.BeginUpdateResourceW.argtypes = [W.LPCWSTR,W.BOOL]
    kernel.BeginUpdateResourceW.restype = W.HANDLE
    kernel.UpdateResourceW.argtypes = [W.HANDLE,C.c_void_p,W.LPCWSTR,W.WORD,C.c_void_p,W.DWORD]
    kernel.UpdateResourceW.restype = W.BOOL
    kernel.EndUpdateResourceW.argtypes = [W.HANDLE,W.BOOL]
    kernel.EndUpdateResourceW.restype = W.BOOL
    handle = kernel.BeginUpdateResourceW(str(exe),False)
    if not handle: raise C.WinError(C.get_last_error())
    data = C.create_string_buffer(archive)
    if not kernel.UpdateResourceW(handle,C.c_void_p(10),'ARCHIVE',0,data,len(archive)):
        error = C.get_last_error()
        kernel.EndUpdateResourceW(handle,True)
        raise C.WinError(error)
    if not kernel.EndUpdateResourceW(handle,False): raise C.WinError(C.get_last_error())
    pe = pefile.PE(str(exe))
    resource = next(e for e in next(e for e in pe.DIRECTORY_ENTRY_RESOURCE.entries if e.id==10).directory.entries if str(e.name)=='ARCHIVE').directory.entries[0].data.struct
    rebuilt = pe.get_data(resource.OffsetToData,resource.Size)
    assert rebuilt == archive
    actual_members = archive_members(rebuilt)
    assert actual_members == members
    actual_xml = unprotect(actual_members[0][2])
    assert actual_xml == xml
    assert len(ET.fromstring(actual_xml).findall('.//AssemblerScript')) == 0
    assert digest(SOURCE.read_bytes()) == EXPECTED
    report = {'version':'1.29.2-REA-Test','exe':exe.name,'exe_bytes':exe.stat().st_size,
        'exe_sha256':digest(exe.read_bytes()),'original_unchanged':True,'archive_members':len(members),
        'archive_roundtrip':True,'old_injection_scripts_removed':True,'original_form_preserved':True,
        'original_runtimes_preserved':True,'adapter_machine':'x86',
        'adapter_dll_sha256':digest(dll_bytes), 'xml_sha256':digest(xml),
        'lua_sha256':digest(script.encode()),'members':[{'name':name,'folder':folder,'sha256':digest(b),'bytes':len(b)} for name,folder,b in members]}
    (OUT/'BUILD_VERIFICATION.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))

if __name__ == '__main__': main()

`work/integrate_original.py`:

```py
import os
"""Add the accepted 1.29.2 backend without deleting the original trainer data."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, ctypes as C, hashlib, json, shutil, struct, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, zlib
from ctypes import wintypes as W
import pefile
from recover_trainer import EXPECTED, protect, unprotect
from build_adapter import archive_members

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
WORK = ROOT/'integrated'
OUT = ROOT.parent/'outputs'/'原版新增1.29.2'
EXE_NAME = 'WarcraftIII_Cheat_1.20e_1.24e_1.27a_1.29.2.exe'
SOURCE = Path(os.environ.get('WAR3_TRAINER_SOURCE', Path.home()/'Downloads'/'Warcraft+Ⅲ+v1.20e1.24e1.27a通用cheat.EXE'))

def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()

def lua_literal(text):
    separator = '===='
    while ']'+separator+']' in text: separator += '='
    return '['+separator+'[\n'+text+']'+separator+']'

def prepare():
    WORK.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    original = ET.parse(ROOT/'recovery_verified'/'original.CT').getroot()
    before = ET.tostring(original.find('CheatEntries'),encoding='utf-8')
    original_lua = original.findtext('LuaScript')
    adapter_lua = (ROOT/'adapter.lua').read_text('utf-8')
    voice_lua = (ROOT/'voice.lua').read_text('utf-8')
    router = (ROOT/'version_router.lua').read_text('utf-8')
    lua = 'local ORIGINAL_SCRIPT = '+lua_literal(original_lua)+'\nlocal ADAPTER_SCRIPT = '+lua_literal(adapter_lua)+'\nlocal VOICE_SCRIPT = '+lua_literal(voice_lua)+'\n'+router
    original.find('LuaScript').text = lua
    xml = ET.tostring(original,encoding='utf-8',xml_declaration=True)
    parsed = ET.fromstring(xml)
    assert ET.tostring(parsed.find('CheatEntries'),encoding='utf-8') == before
    baseline = ET.parse(ROOT/'recovery_verified'/'original.CT').getroot()
    assert ET.tostring(parsed.find('Forms'),encoding='utf-8') == ET.tostring(baseline.find('Forms'),encoding='utf-8')
    assert len(parsed.findall('.//CheatEntry')) == 53
    assert len(parsed.findall('.//AssemblerScript')) == 37
    assert unprotect(protect(xml)) == xml
    (WORK/'integrated.CT').write_bytes(xml)
    (WORK/'integrated.lua').write_text(lua,encoding='utf-8')
    report = {'kind':'original-plus-129','original_records_preserved':53,'original_assembler_scripts_preserved':37,
        'original_records_byte_equivalent_after_xml_serialization':True,'original_form_preserved':True,
        'original_lua_sha256':sha(original_lua.encode()),'adapter_lua_sha256':sha(adapter_lua.encode()),
        'integrated_lua_sha256':sha(lua.encode()),'integrated_xml_sha256':sha(xml),
        'chinese_voice':True,'voice_lua_sha256':sha(voice_lua.encode()),'speech_mode':'Local CE SAPI, language 804, async + purge + XML',
        'voice_result_policy':'1.29.2 reports response/readback; original three versions report dispatch only',
        'original_versions':['1.20e','1.24e','1.27a'],'added_version':'1.29.2.9231',
        'routing':'One backend per launch; inactive original hotkeys suppressed in memory',
        'user_acceptance':'User reported the previous 1.29.2 test passed; no claim that all functions were independently runtime-tested'}
    (WORK/'INTEGRATION_VERIFICATION.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    return xml, report

def write_exe(xml, report):
    source = SOURCE.read_bytes()
    assert sha(source) == EXPECTED
    dll = (ROOT/'adapter_native'/'legacy_adapter.dll').read_bytes()
    native = json.loads((ROOT/'adapter_native'/'BUILD_VERIFICATION.json').read_text('utf-8'))
    assert sha(dll) == native['dll_sha256'] and native['ok']
    manifest = json.loads((ROOT/'recovery_verified'/'archive_manifest.json').read_text('utf-8'))
    members = []
    for entry in manifest:
        name, folder = entry['name'],entry['folder']
        b = protect(xml) if name == 'CET_TRAINER.CETRAINER' else (ROOT/'unpacked'/folder/name).read_bytes()
        if name != 'CET_TRAINER.CETRAINER': assert sha(b) == entry['sha256']
        members.append((name,folder,b))
    members.append(('legacy_adapter.dll','',dll))
    payload = bytearray()
    for name,folder,b in members:
        for value in (name.encode(),folder.encode(),b): payload.extend(struct.pack('<I',len(value))+value)
    c = zlib.compressobj(9,zlib.DEFLATED,-15)
    archive = struct.pack('<I',len(members))+c.compress(payload)+c.flush()
    assert archive_members(archive) == members
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    exe = OUT/EXE_NAME
    if exe.exists():
        raise FileExistsError('Existing deliverable is preserved: ' + str(exe))
    # A functional multiversion build, not a renamed copy of the quarantined file.
    shutil.copyfile(SOURCE,exe)
    k=C.WinDLL('kernel32',use_last_error=True)
    k.BeginUpdateResourceW.argtypes=[W.LPCWSTR,W.BOOL];k.BeginUpdateResourceW.restype=W.HANDLE
    k.UpdateResourceW.argtypes=[W.HANDLE,C.c_void_p,W.LPCWSTR,W.WORD,C.c_void_p,W.DWORD];k.UpdateResourceW.restype=W.BOOL
    k.EndUpdateResourceW.argtypes=[W.HANDLE,W.BOOL];k.EndUpdateResourceW.restype=W.BOOL
    handle=k.BeginUpdateResourceW(str(exe),False)
    if not handle: raise C.WinError(C.get_last_error())
    data=C.create_string_buffer(archive)
    if not k.UpdateResourceW(handle,C.c_void_p(10),'ARCHIVE',0,data,len(archive)):
        err=C.get_last_error();k.EndUpdateResourceW(handle,True);raise C.WinError(err)
    if not k.EndUpdateResourceW(handle,False):raise C.WinError(C.get_last_error())
    pe=pefile.PE(str(exe))
    entry=next(e for e in next(e for e in pe.DIRECTORY_ENTRY_RESOURCE.entries if e.id==10).directory.entries if str(e.name)=='ARCHIVE').directory.entries[0].data.struct
    rebuilt=pe.get_data(entry.OffsetToData,entry.Size)
    assert rebuilt==archive and archive_members(rebuilt)==members
    assert sha(SOURCE.read_bytes())==EXPECTED
    report.update({'exe':exe.name,'exe_sha256':sha(exe.read_bytes()),'exe_bytes':exe.stat().st_size,
        'archive_roundtrip':True,'archive_members':len(members),'adapter_dll_sha256':sha(dll),
        'original_runtime_files_unchanged':True,'original_input_unchanged':True})
    (OUT/'INTEGRATION_VERIFICATION.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    return report

if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--build-exe',action='store_true');parser.add_argument('--voice-build',action='store_true');args=parser.parse_args()
    if args.voice_build:
        OUT = ROOT.parent/'outputs'/'原版新增1.29.2_语音版'
        EXE_NAME = 'WarcraftIII_Cheat_MultiVersion_Voice.exe'
    xml,report=prepare()
    if args.build_exe:report=write_exe(xml,report)
    print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=True,indent=2))

function CETrainer_CEToggleBox1Click(sender)
  if busy then return end
  if not CETrainer.CEToggleBox1.Checked then
    disconnect(true)
    status('已断开')
    return
  end
  if not adapter then
    disconnect()
    if voice then voice.say('修改器组件未能加载') end
    showMessage('适配组件未能加载，请完整重新解压测试版。')
    return
  end
  local ok, result = pcall(adapter.connect)
  if not ok or type(result) ~= 'table' or not result.ok then
    disconnect()
    local message = (type(result) == 'table' and explain(result)) or tostring(result)
    if voice then voice.say('游戏连接失败') end
    status('连接失败')
    showMessage(message)
    return
  end
  connected, targetPid = true, result.pid
  CETrainer.CEToggleBox1.Caption = '已连接：回游戏使用快捷键'
  status('已连接；落点为镜头中心')
  if voice then voice.say('修改器已连接') end
end

local function integerText(edit)
  local s = tostring(edit.Text)
  if not s:match('^%d+$') then return nil end
  local n = tonumber(s)
  if not n or n &lt; 0 or n &gt; 100000 then return nil end
  return n
end

local function action(op)
  -- Generic CE hotkeys are global; ignore them outside the connected game.
  if not connected or busy or targetPid == 0 or getForegroundProcess() ~= targetPid then return end
  local now = getTickCount()
  if now &gt;= lastPress and now-lastPress &lt; 350 then return end
  lastPress = now
  local a, b, c = 0, 0, 0
  if op == 2 then
    a = integerText(CETrainer.CEEdit1)
    b = integerText(CETrainer.CEEdit2)
    c = integerText(CETrainer.CEEdit3)
    if not a or not b or not c then
      if voice then voice.failure(104) end
      showMessage('力量、敏捷、智力请输入 0 到 100000 的整数。')
      return
    end
  end
  local unit = CETrainer.CEComboBox1.ItemIndex+1
  local item = CETrainer.CEComboBox2.ItemIndex+1
  local skill = CETrainer.CEComboBox3.ItemIndex+1
  if (op == 11 and (unit &lt; 1 or unit &gt; 814)) or
     (op == 12 and (item &lt; 1 or item &gt; 273)) or
     (op == 13 and (skill &lt; 1 or skill &gt; 778)) then
    if voice then voice.say('请先选择对应条目') end
    showMessage('请先在对应下拉框中选择单位、物品或技能。')
    return
  end
  busy = true
  local ok, result = pcall(adapter.request, op, a, b, c, unit, item, skill)
  busy = false
  if not ok or type(result) ~= 'table' then
    disconnect()
    if voice then voice.failure(116) end
    status('操作异常，已断开')
    showMessage(tostring(result))
    return
  end
  if not result.ok then
    if result.fatal then disconnect() end
    if voice then voice.failure(result.error) end
    status('操作未完成')
    showMessage(explain(result))
    return
  end
  CETrainer['CHEAT' .. (op-1)].setActive(true, 1000)
  local summary = '完成；处理 ' .. tostring(result.applied) .. ' 个目标'
  if op == 1 then summary = '英雄等级：' .. tostring(result.level) end
  if op == 8 or op == 11 then summary = '已在镜头中心新建单位' end
  if op == 10 then summary = '已请求瞬移至镜头中心；落点受地形影响' end
  if op == 12 then summary = '已在镜头中心创建物品' end
  if op == 14 then summary = '已处理 ' .. result.applied .. ' 项已有技能；等级受地图限制' end
  if op == 15 then summary = '已处理 ' .. result.applied .. ' 项科技；等级受地图限制' end
  if op == 16 then summary = '金木与食物上限已设置：' .. result.gold end
  if op == 17 then summary = '已开启全图可见；断开连接时关闭' end
  if op == 18 then summary = '已复活 ' .. result.applied .. ' 个英雄' end
  status(summary)
  if voice then voice.success(op,result) end
end

local VOICE_SCRIPT = [====[
-- Chinese feedback through CE's existing local SAPI interface; no downloads.
-- CE 7.2 supports speak(text, flags). 11 = async + purge previous + XML.
local voice = {enabled=true}
local names = {'英雄升级','英雄属性设置','增加技能点','开启无敌','取消无敌','重置冷却',
  '补满生命魔法','新建同类型单位','移除单位','瞬移','创建单位','创建物品',
  '添加技能','升级技能','升级科技','设置资源','开启地图可见','复活英雄'}

function voice.say(text)
  if not voice.enabled or type(speak) ~= 'function' then return false end
  local escaped = tostring(text):gsub('&amp;','&amp;amp;'):gsub('&lt;','&amp;lt;'):gsub('&gt;','&amp;gt;')
  local ok = pcall(speak, '&lt;voice required="Language=804"&gt;' .. escaped .. '&lt;/voice&gt;', 11)
  return ok
end

function voice.success(op, result)
  local messages = {'英雄等级，' .. tostring(result.level or 0) .. '级','英雄属性已设置',
    '技能点已增加','无敌指令已执行','取消无敌指令已执行','冷却重置指令已执行',
    '生命魔法已补满','已新建同类型单位','单位已移除','瞬移指令已执行',
    '单位已创建','物品已创建','技能已添加',
    '已处理' .. tostring(result.applied or 0) .. '项技能',
    '已处理' .. tostring(result.applied or 0) .. '项科技',
    '黄金木材食物上限已设置','地图可见指令已执行',
    '已复活' .. tostring(result.applied or 0) .. '个英雄'}
  return voice.say(messages[op] or '操作已处理')
end

function voice.failure(code)
  local messages = {[103]='请先进入地图',[104]='输入不正确',[105]='请先选中单位',
    [106]='请先选中英雄',[108]='可能部分生效，请查看游戏',
    [110]='地图已变化，请重新连接',[112]='操作超时，结果未知',

    [117]='没有适用目标'}
  return voice.say(messages[code] or '操作未完成')
end

function voice.sent(op)
  -- The original three backends have no completion ACK: announce dispatch only.
  return voice.say('已发送' .. (names[op] or '操作') .. '指令')
end

return voice

-- Integration change: keep the original records, but enable only one backend.
-- Original Lua and the accepted 1.29.2 Lua are supplied by the build script.
local addressList = getAddressList()
-- Load feedback once; both old and new backends use this same local speech API.
WAR3_TRAINER_VOICE = assert(load(VOICE_SCRIPT, '@voice.lua', 't', _G))()
local legacyPath = [[e:\games\warcraft iii (legacy)\warcraft iii.exe]]
local originalHotkeys = {}
for i=0,addressList.Count-1 do
  local record = addressList.getMemoryRecord(i)
  for j=0,record.HotkeyCount-1 do
    local hotkey = record.getHotkey(j)
    originalHotkeys[#originalHotkeys+1] = {hotkey=hotkey, keys=hotkey.Keys}
  end
end

local function setOriginalHotkeys(active)
  -- CE 7.2 has no MemoryRecordHotkey.Active property. Its hotkey thread reads
  -- Keys directly, so clear/restore Keys without destroying record IDs.
  for _,entry in ipairs(originalHotkeys) do
    entry.hotkey.Keys = active and entry.keys or {}
  end
end

-- Keep record definitions in the file. Suppression is only for this session.
setOriginalHotkeys(false)

local function normalized(path)
  return tostring(path or ''):gsub('/', '\\'):lower()
end

local function processes()
  local old, current = {}, {}
  local ok, list = pcall(getProcesslist)
  if not ok or type(list) ~= 'table' then return old, current end
  for id,name in pairs(list) do
    local pid = tonumber(id)
    local basename = tostring(name):gsub('^.*[\\/]', ''):lower()
    if pid and (basename == 'war3.exe' or basename == 'warcraft iii.exe') then
      local loaded, modules = pcall(enumModules, pid)
      if loaded and type(modules) == 'table' then
        for _,module in pairs(modules) do
          if basename == 'war3.exe' and tostring(module.Name):lower() == 'game.dll' then
            old[#old+1] = pid
            break
          elseif basename == 'warcraft iii.exe' and normalized(module.PathToFile) == legacyPath and not module.Is64Bit then
            current[#current+1] = pid
            break
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return old, current
end

local function chooseMode()
  local old, current = processes()
  if #current == 1 and #old == 0 then return '129' end
  if #old == 1 and #current == 0 then return 'original' end
  local foreground = getForegroundProcess()
  if #current == 1 and foreground == current[1] then return '129' end
  if #old == 1 and foreground == old[1] then return 'original' end
  local choices = createStringlist()
  choices.add('原版：1.20e / 1.24e / 1.27a')
  choices.add('新增：1.29.2.9231（Legacy）')
  local index = showSelectionList('选择游戏版本',
    '未检测到唯一游戏，请选择本次使用的版本。切换版本时重新打开修改器。', choices, false)
  choices.destroy()
  if index == 0 then return 'original' end
  if index == 1 then return '129' end
  return nil
end

local function execute(script, name)
  local chunk, errorText = load(script, name, 't', _G)
  if not chunk then error(errorText) end
  chunk()
end

local mode = chooseMode()
if not mode then closeCE(); return end
if mode == '129' then
  -- Original dwei/old Game.dll hotkeys stay disabled while new hotkeys run.
  WAR3_INTEGRATED_MODE = true
  execute(ADAPTER_SCRIPT, '@adapter_129.lua')
  return
end

execute(ORIGINAL_SCRIPT, '@original.lua')
CETrainer.Caption = 'Warcraft III 通用cheat | 原版 1.20e / 1.24e / 1.27a | 中文语音版'

      CETrainer.CEToggleBox1.Checked = false
      WAR3_TRAINER_VOICE.say('未找到原版游戏')
      showMessage('请先启动一份原版支持的 War3.exe，再激活。1.29.2 请重新打开修改器并选择新增版本。')
      return
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(openProcess, old[1])
    if not ok or result == false or getOpenedProcessID() ~= old[1] then
      CETrainer.CEToggleBox1.Checked = false

    CETrainer.CEToggleBox1.Checked = false

  setOriginalHotkeys(activating)

local ADAPTER_SCRIPT = [====[
-- 1.29.2 port: retain the recovered form and lists; replace old Game.dll hooks.
local adapter, connected, busy, targetPid = nil, false, false, 0
local hotkeys, lastPress = {}, -1000
local voice = WAR3_TRAINER_VOICE -- Optional shared feedback in the voice build.
local title = WAR3_INTEGRATED_MODE and 'Warcraft III 通用cheat | 1.29.2.9231' or 'Warcraft III Legacy 1.29.2 - Test'
if voice then title = title .. ' | 中文语音版' end
local errors = {
  [101]='连接响应不符，请重新连接。',
  [102]='游戏版本不匹配；仅支持指定目录的 1.29.2.9231。',
  [103]='请先进入单人地图，再连接修改器。',
  [104]='输入超出允许范围。',
  [105]='请先在游戏里选中单位。',
  [106]='当前所选单位不是英雄。',
  [107]='单位数量超过本版处理上限，操作已停止。',
  [108]='读回结果未完全符合请求；部分修改可能已经生效，请先查看游戏。',
  [109]='操作未成功，请检查该单位、物品或技能是否可用于当前地图。',
  [110]='地图已经变化，请加载完成后重新连接。',
  [111]='请切回已连接的游戏窗口使用快捷键。',
  [112]='等待游戏响应超时，结果尚不确定；已停止，不会自动重试。',
  [113]='无法连接游戏。请从指定目录启动游戏，并确认运行权限一致。',
  [114]='已有操作正在处理，请稍候。',
  [115]='当前游戏接口与已适配版本不符，已停止操作。',
  [116]='游戏调用发生异常，结果可能已部分生效；请先查看游戏。',
  [117]='没有适用的单位、已有技能或阵亡英雄。'
}

local function explain(result)
  return errors[result.error] or result.message or '操作未完成，请检查游戏状态。'
end

local function status(text)
  CETrainer.Caption = title .. ' | ' .. text
end

local function disconnect(announce)
  if adapter then pcall(adapter.close) end
  connected, targetPid = false, 0
  CETrainer.CEToggleBox1.Checked = false
  CETrainer.CEToggleBox1.Caption = '点击连接 1.29.2 游戏'
  if announce and voice then voice.say('修改器已断开') end
end

-- Existing form callbacks are retained by name so the binary form loads cleanly.
function CETrainer_CEEdit1EditingDone(sender) end
function CETrainer_CEEdit2EditingDone(sender) end
function CETrainer_CEEdit3EditingDone(sender) end
function CETrainer_CEComboBox1Select(sender) end
function CETrainer_CEComboBox2Select(sender) end
function CETrainer_CEComboBox3Select(sender) end

function CETrainer_CEToggleBox1Click(sender)
  if busy then return end
  if not CETrainer.CEToggleBox1.Checked then
    disconnect(true)
    status('已断开')
    return
  end
  if not adapter then
    disconnect()
    if voice then voice.say('修改器组件未能加载') end
    showMessage('适配组件未能加载，请完整重新解压测试版。')
    return
  end
  local ok, result = pcall(adapter.connect)
  if not ok or type(result) ~= 'table' or not result.ok then
    disconnect()
    local message = (type(result) == 'table' and explain(result)) or tostring(result)
    if voice then voice.say('游戏连接失败') end
    status('连接失败')
    showMessage(message)
    return
  end
  connected, targetPid = true, result.pid
  CETrainer.CEToggleBox1.Caption = '已连接：回游戏使用快捷键'
  status('已连接；落点为镜头中心')
  if voice then voice.say('修改器已连接') end
end

local function integerText(edit)
  local s = tostring(edit.Text)
  if not s:match('^%d+$') then return nil end
  local n = tonumber(s)
  if not n or n < 0 or n > 100000 then return nil end
  return n
end

local function action(op)
  -- Generic CE hotkeys are global; ignore them outside the connected game.
  if not connected or busy or targetPid == 0 or getForegroundProcess() ~= targetPid then return end
  local now = getTickCount()
  if now >= lastPress and now-lastPress < 350 then return end
  lastPress = now
  local a, b, c = 0, 0, 0
  if op == 2 then
    a = integerText(CETrainer.CEEdit1)
    b = integerText(CETrainer.CEEdit2)
    c = integerText(CETrainer.CEEdit3)
    if not a or not b or not c then
      if voice then voice.failure(104) end
      showMessage('力量、敏捷、智力请输入 0 到 100000 的整数。')
      return
    end
  end
  local unit = CETrainer.CEComboBox1.ItemIndex+1
  local item = CETrainer.CEComboBox2.ItemIndex+1
  local skill = CETrainer.CEComboBox3.ItemIndex+1
  if (op == 11 and (unit < 1 or unit > 814)) or
     (op == 12 and (item < 1 or item > 273)) or
     (op == 13 and (skill < 1 or skill > 778)) then
    if voice then voice.say('请先选择对应条目') end
    showMessage('请先在对应下拉框中选择单位、物品或技能。')
    return
  end
  busy = true
  local ok, result = pcall(adapter.request, op, a, b, c, unit, item, skill)
  busy = false
  if not ok or type(result) ~= 'table' then
    disconnect()
    if voice then voice.failure(116) end
    status('操作异常，已断开')
    showMessage(tostring(result))
    return
  end
  if not result.ok then
    if result.fatal then disconnect() end
    if voice then voice.failure(result.error) end
    status('操作未完成')
    showMessage(explain(result))
    return
  end

-- Integration change: keep the original records, but enable only one backend.
-- Original Lua and the accepted 1.29.2 Lua are supplied by the build script.
local addressList = getAddressList()
-- Load feedback once; both old and new backends use this same local speech API.
WAR3_TRAINER_VOICE = assert(load(VOICE_SCRIPT, '@voice.lua', 't', _G))()
local legacyPath = [[e:\games\warcraft iii (legacy)\warcraft iii.exe]]
local originalHotkeys = {}
for i=0,addressList.Count-1 do
  local record = addressList.getMemoryRecord(i)
  for j=0,record.HotkeyCount-1 do
    local hotkey = record.getHotkey(j)
    originalHotkeys[#originalHotkeys+1] = {hotkey=hotkey, keys=hotkey.Keys}
  end
end

local function setOriginalHotkeys(active)
  -- CE 7.2 has no MemoryRecordHotkey.Active property. Its hotkey thread reads
  -- Keys directly, so clear/restore Keys without destroying record IDs.
  for _,entry in ipairs(originalHotkeys) do
    entry.hotkey.Keys = active and entry.keys or {}
  end
end

-- Keep record definitions in the file. Suppression is only for this session.
setOriginalHotkeys(false)

local function normalized(path)
  return tostring(path or ''):gsub('/', '\\'):lower()
end

local function processes()
  local old, current = {}, {}
  local ok, list = pcall(getProcesslist)
  if not ok or type(list) ~= 'table' then return old, current end
  for id,name in pairs(list) do
    local pid = tonumber(id)
    local basename = tostring(name):gsub('^.*[\\/]', ''):lower()
    if pid and (basename == 'war3.exe' or basename == 'warcraft iii.exe') then
      local loaded, modules = pcall(enumModules, pid)
      if loaded and type(modules) == 'table' then
        for _,module in pairs(modules) do
          if basename == 'war3.exe' and tostring(module.Name):lower() == 'game.dll' then
            old[#old+1] = pid
            break
          elseif basename == 'warcraft iii.exe' and normalized(module.PathToFile) == legacyPath and not module.Is64Bit then
            current[#current+1] = pid
            break
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return old, current
end

local function chooseMode()
  local old, current = processes()
  if #current == 1 and #old == 0 then return '129' end
  if #old == 1 and #current == 0 then return 'original' end
  local foreground = getForegroundProcess()
  if #current == 1 and foreground == current[1] then return '129' end
  if #old == 1 and foreground == old[1] then return 'original' end
  local choices = createStringlist()
  choices.add('原版：1.20e / 1.24e / 1.27a')
  choices.add('新增：1.29.2.9231（Legacy）')
  local index = showSelectionList('选择游戏版本',
    '未检测到唯一游戏，请选择本次使用的版本。切换版本时重新打开修改器。', choices, false)
  choices.destroy()
  if index == 0 then return 'original' end
  if index == 1 then return '129' end
  return nil
end

local function execute(script, name)
  local chunk, errorText = load(script, name, 't', _G)
  if not chunk then error(errorText) end
  chunk()
end

local mode = chooseMode()
if not mode then closeCE(); return end
if mode == '129' then
