`work/recover_trainer.py`:

```py
"""Execution-free recovery of this supplied CE standalone trainer.

Based on CE's frmExeTrainerGeneratorUnit.pas, OpenSave.pas and custombase85.pas.
No embedded executable, DLL, Lua or assembler script is executed.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, hashlib, json, re, struct, zlib
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import pefile

EXPECTED = 'cd994b9a29776ad488dd76a21776cb22dd2cc774ac4a55720d7b9e17dda07573'
ALPHABET = '0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz!#$%()*+,-./:;=?@[]^_{}'

def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def unprotect(data):
    m = bytearray(data)
    for i in range(2, len(m)):
        m[i] ^= m[i-2]
    for i in range(len(m)-2, -1, -1):
        m[i] ^= m[i+1]
    for i in range(len(m)):
        m[i] ^= (0xce+i) & 255
    assert m[:5] == b'CHEAT'
    x = zlib.decompress(m[5:], -15)
    assert struct.unpack_from('<I', x)[0] == len(x)-4
    return x[4:]

def protect(xml):
    c = zlib.compressobj(9, zlib.DEFLATED, -15)
    m = bytearray(b'CHEAT' + c.compress(struct.pack('<I', len(xml))+xml) + c.flush())
    for i in range(len(m)):
        m[i] ^= (0xce+i) & 255
    for i in range(len(m)-1):
        m[i] ^= m[i+1]
    for i in range(len(m)-1, 1, -1):
        m[i] ^= m[i-2]
    return bytes(m)

def base85_decode(s):
    out = bytearray()
    for i in range(0, len(s), 5):
        chunk = s[i:i+5]
        assert len(chunk) > 1
        n = 0
        for c in chunk.ljust(5, ALPHABET[-1]):
            n = n*85 + ALPHABET.index(c)
        out.extend(n.to_bytes(4, 'big')[:len(chunk)-1])
    return bytes(out)

class FormReader:
    """Read FPC/Lazarus TPF0 component values without loading components."""
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.data, self.pos = data, 0
    def take(self, n):
        assert 0 <= n <= len(self.data)-self.pos
        b = self.data[self.pos:self.pos+n]
        self.pos += n
        return b
    def number(self, fmt):
        return struct.unpack(fmt, self.take(struct.calcsize(fmt)))[0]
    def short(self):
        return self.take(self.number('<B')).decode('utf-8')
    def value(self):
        t = self.number('<B')
        if t == 0: return None
        if t == 1:
            out = []
            while self.data[self.pos]: out.append(self.value())
            self.pos += 1
            return out
        if t in (2,3,4,19): return self.number({2:'<b',3:'<h',4:'<i',19:'<q'}[t])
        if t in (6,7): return self.short()
        if t in (8,9): return t == 9
        if t == 10:
            b = self.take(self.number('<I'))
            return {'binary_bytes':len(b), 'sha256':sha(b)}
        if t == 11:
            out = []
            while self.data[self.pos]: out.append(self.short())
            self.pos += 1
            return out
        if t in (12,20): return self.take(self.number('<I')).decode('utf-8')
        if t == 13: return None
        if t == 14:
            out = []
            while self.data[self.pos]:
                assert self.number('<B') == 1
                out.append(self.props())
            self.pos += 1
            return out
        if t == 15: return self.number('<f')
        if t in (16,17): return self.number('<d')
        if t == 18: return self.take(self.number('<I')*2).decode('utf-16le')
        if t == 5: return {'extended80_hex':self.take(10).hex()}
        raise ValueError((t, self.pos))
    def props(self):
        out = {}
        while self.data[self.pos]:
            k = self.short()
            out[k] = self.value()
        self.pos += 1
        return out
    def component(self):
        assert self.data[self.pos] < 0xf0, ('unsupported component flags', self.pos)
        cls, name = self.short(), self.short()
        props = self.props()
        children = []
        while self.data[self.pos]: children.append(self.component())
        self.pos += 1
        return {'class':cls, 'name':name, 'properties':props, 'children':children}

def recover(source, out, materialize=False):
    raw = source.read_bytes()
    assert sha(raw) == EXPECTED, 'Different input: refuse to confuse identities'
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    pe = pefile.PE(data=raw)
    rc = {str(e.name):e for e in next(e for e in pe.DIRECTORY_ENTRY_RESOURCE.entries if e.id == 10).directory.entries}
    def resource(name):
        e = rc[name].directory.entries[0].data.struct
        return pe.get_data(e.OffsetToData, e.Size)
    archive = resource('ARCHIVE')
    count = struct.unpack_from('<I', archive)[0]
    payload = zlib.decompress(archive[4:], -15)
    at, members, trainer = 0, [], None
    def u32():
        nonlocal at
        n = struct.unpack_from('<I', payload, at)[0]
        at += 4
        return n
    def take(n):
        nonlocal at
        assert n <= len(payload)-at
        b = payload[at:at+n]
        at += n
        return b
    for _ in range(count):
        name, folder = take(u32()).decode(), take(u32()).decode()
        b = take(u32())
        members.append({'name':name, 'folder':folder, 'bytes':len(b), 'sha256':sha(b)})
        if name == 'CET_TRAINER.CETRAINER': trainer = b
        if materialize:
            # Rebuild preparation may extract runtimes, but never executes them.
            relative = Path(folder.replace('\\','/'))/name
            assert not relative.is_absolute() and '..' not in relative.parts and ':' not in str(relative)
            runtime_root = (out.parent/'unpacked').resolve()
            target = (runtime_root/relative).resolve()
            target.relative_to(runtime_root)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            if target.exists(): assert target.read_bytes() == b, 'Refuse to replace a different extracted file'
            else: target.write_bytes(b)
    assert at == len(payload) and trainer is not None
    xml = unprotect(trainer)
    assert unprotect(protect(xml)) == xml, 'Protection round-trip failed'
    (out/'original.CT').write_bytes(xml)
    tree = ET.fromstring(xml)
    (out/'original.lua').write_text(tree.findtext('LuaScript'), encoding='utf-8')
    entries = []
    scripts = out/'assembler'
    scripts.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    rawcode_tables = {}
    for entry in tree.findall('.//CheatEntry'):
        ident = entry.findtext('ID')
        script = entry.findtext('AssemblerScript')
        desc = entry.findtext('Description', '').strip('"')
        row = {'id':ident, 'description':desc, 'type':entry.findtext('VariableType'),
               'address':entry.findtext('Address'), 'hotkeys':[]}
        for hk in entry.findall('Hotkeys/Hotkey'):
            row['hotkeys'].append({'action':hk.findtext('Action'), 'value':hk.findtext('Value'),
                'keys':[k.text for k in hk.findall('Keys/Key')]})
        if script is not None:
            path = scripts/f'record_{ident}.asm'
            path.write_text(script, encoding='utf-8')
            row['script'] = path.relative_to(out).as_posix()
        if ident in ('164','165','175','176'):
            b = bytes.fromhex(re.search(r'(?m)^db\s+([\da-fA-F\s]+)', script)[1])
            assert len(b)%4 == 0 and b[:4] == b'\0'*4
            rawcode_tables[ident] = [b[i:i+4][::-1].decode('ascii') for i in range(4,len(b),4)]
        entries.append(row)
    frm = zlib.decompress(base85_decode(tree.find('Forms/CETrainer').text), -15)
    assert struct.unpack_from('<I', frm)[0] == len(frm)-4
    (out/'CETrainer.form.bin').write_bytes(frm[4:])
    reader = FormReader(frm[4:]); assert reader.take(4) == b'TPF0'
    form = reader.component(); assert reader.pos == len(reader.data)
    for name,obj in [('form.json',form),('entries.json',entries),('rawcodes.json',rawcode_tables),('archive_manifest.json',members)]:
        (out/name).write_text(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    result = {'source_sha256':sha(raw), 'source_bytes':len(raw), 'xml_sha256':sha(xml), 'xml_bytes':len(xml),
        'cetrainer_sha256':sha(trainer), 'archive_members':count, 'cheat_records':len(entries),
        'assembler_scripts':sum('script' in e for e in entries), 'lua_lines':len(tree.findtext('LuaScript').splitlines()),
        'form_bytes':len(frm)-4, 'form_parsed_fully':True, 'protection_roundtrip':True,
        'rawcode_counts':{k:len(v) for k,v in rawcode_tables.items()}, 'target_executed':False}
    (out/'RECOVERY_VERIFICATION.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('source', type=Path)
    ap.add_argument('out', type=Path)
    ap.add_argument('--extract-runtimes',action='store_true',help='Materialize original runtimes for rebuild; never execute them')
    a = ap.parse_args()
    recover(a.source, a.out, a.extract_runtimes)
```

`work/synthesize_voice.py`:

```py
"""Verify the installed 32-bit Chinese SAPI voice without accessing the game."""
from pathlib import Path
import json, os, subprocess, wave

output = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent/'outputs'/'原版新增1.29.2_语音版'
output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wav = output/'中文语音示例.wav'
environment = dict(os.environ, WAR3_VOICE_OUTPUT=str(wav),
                   WAR3_VOICE_TEXT='修改器已连接。英雄等级，十级。请先选中英雄。')
# Inline COM commands need no script-policy or security-setting changes.
command = r'''
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
[Console]::OutputEncoding=New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding
$speaker=New-Object -ComObject SAPI.SpVoice
$tokens=$speaker.GetVoices('Language=804')
if($tokens.Count -lt 1){throw 'No Simplified Chinese SAPI voice is available.'}
$speaker.Voice=$tokens.Item(0)
$stream=New-Object -ComObject SAPI.SpFileStream
try {
  $stream.Open($env:WAR3_VOICE_OUTPUT,3,$false)
  $speaker.AudioOutputStream=$stream
  $text=[System.Security.SecurityElement]::Escape($env:WAR3_VOICE_TEXT)
  $speaker.Speak(('<voice required="Language=804">'+$text+'</voice>'),8)|Out-Null
} finally {$stream.Close()}
[pscustomobject]@{voice=$speaker.Voice.GetDescription();process_bits=([IntPtr]::Size*8)}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress
'''
result = subprocess.run([r'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe',
                         '-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-Command',command],
                        env=environment, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
if result.returncode:
    raise RuntimeError(result.stderr.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
report = json.loads(result.stdout.decode('utf-8-sig'))
with wave.open(str(wav),'rb') as audio:
    report.update(wav=wav.name, seconds=audio.getnframes()/audio.getframerate(),
                  sample_rate=audio.getframerate(), channels=audio.getnchannels())
assert report['process_bits']==32 and report['seconds']>1
report.update(ok=True, game_access=False, security_settings_changed=False,
              scope='32-bit Windows SAPI file synthesis; no in-game hotkey audio acceptance')
(output/'SAPI_VOICE_PROBE.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=True))
```

`work/test_adapter_lua.py`:

```py
import os
"""Execute only authored UI Lua against mocks, using the installed Lua runtime."""
from pathlib import Path
import ctypes as C

lua = C.CDLL(os.environ.get('WAR3_LUA64', r'D:\Cheat Engine 7.6\lua53-64.dll'))
lua.luaL_newstate.restype = C.c_void_p
lua.luaL_openlibs.argtypes = [C.c_void_p]
lua.luaL_loadstring.argtypes = [C.c_void_p, C.c_char_p]
lua.lua_pcallk.argtypes = [C.c_void_p, C.c_int, C.c_int, C.c_int, C.c_int64, C.c_void_p]
lua.lua_tolstring.argtypes = [C.c_void_p, C.c_int, C.POINTER(C.c_size_t)]
lua.lua_tolstring.restype = C.c_char_p
lua.lua_close.argtypes = [C.c_void_p]

mock = r'''
calls, keys, messages, spoken = {}, {}, {}, {}
function speak(text, flags)
  assert(flags==11 and text:find('Language=804',1,true))
  spoken[#spoken+1]=text
end
local controls = {}
for _,name in ipairs({'CEEdit1','CEEdit2','CEEdit3','CEComboBox1','CEComboBox2','CEComboBox3','CEToggleBox1'}) do
  controls[name] = {Text='',ItemIndex=-1,Checked=false}
end
for i=0,36 do controls['CHEAT'..i] = {setActive=function() end} end
CETrainer = setmetatable({show=function() end}, {__index=controls})
foreground, tick, response = 1234, 1000, {ok=true,pid=1234,applied=1,message='done',level=10}
package.loadlib = function() return function() return {
  connect=function() return {ok=true,pid=1234} end,
  close=function() end,
  request=function(...) calls[#calls+1]={...};return response end
} end end
function showMessage(m) messages[#messages+1]=m end
function createHotkey(fn, ctrl, key)
  keys[key]=fn
  return {destroy=function() end}
end
function getForegroundProcess() return foreground end
function getTickCount() return tick end
function getCheatEngineDir() return '' end
function closeCE() end
caFree=2
'''
checks = r'''
assert(CETrainer.CEEdit1.Text=='100')
keys[0x41]();assert(#calls==0 and #spoken==0, 'Disconnected hotkey must do nothing')
CETrainer.CEToggleBox1.Checked=true;CETrainer_CEToggleBox1Click()
assert(#spoken==1 and spoken[1]:find('修改器已连接',1,true))
foreground=777;keys[0x41]();assert(#calls==0 and #spoken==1, 'Foreign foreground must do nothing')
foreground=1234;keys[0x41]();assert(#calls==1 and calls[1][1]==1)
assert(#spoken==2 and spoken[2]:find('英雄等级，10级',1,true))
keys[0x41]();assert(#calls==1 and #spoken==2, 'Key repeat must be throttled')
tick=tick+500;CETrainer.CEEdit1.Text='-1';keys[0x42]();assert(#calls==1)

tick=tick+500;CETrainer.CEEdit1.Text='3.5';keys[0x42]();assert(#calls==1)

    if not code:

    if code:
        raise RuntimeError(lua.lua_tolstring(state,-1,None).decode('utf-8'))
```

```py
from pathlib import Path
import unittest
from test_integration import lua

class VoiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_lua(self, checks):

            lua.luaL_openlibs(s)
```

`work/version_router.lua`:

```lua
-- Integration change: keep the original records, but enable only one backend.
-- Original Lua and the accepted 1.29.2 Lua are supplied by the build script.
local addressList = getAddressList()
-- Load feedback once; both old and new backends use this same local speech API.
WAR3_TRAINER_VOICE = assert(load(VOICE_SCRIPT, '@voice.lua', 't', _G))()
local legacyPath = [[e:\games\warcraft iii (legacy)\warcraft iii.exe]]
local originalHotkeys = {}
for i=0,addressList.Count-1 do
  local record = addressList.getMemoryRecord(i)
  for j=0,record.HotkeyCount-1 do
    local hotkey = record.getHotkey(j)
    originalHotkeys[#originalHotkeys+1] = {hotkey=hotkey, keys=hotkey.Keys}
  end
end

local function setOriginalHotkeys(active)
  -- CE 7.2 has no MemoryRecordHotkey.Active property. Its hotkey thread reads
  -- Keys directly, so clear/restore Keys without destroying record IDs.
  for _,entry in ipairs(originalHotkeys) do
    entry.hotkey.Keys = active and entry.keys or {}
  end
end

-- Keep record definitions in the file. Suppression is only for this session.
setOriginalHotkeys(false)

local function normalized(path)
  return tostring(path or ''):gsub('/', '\\'):lower()
end

local function processes()
  local old, current = {}, {}
  local ok, list = pcall(getProcesslist)
  if not ok or type(list) ~= 'table' then return old, current end
  for id,name in pairs(list) do
    local pid = tonumber(id)
    local basename = tostring(name):gsub('^.*[\\/]', ''):lower()
    if pid and (basename == 'war3.exe' or basename == 'warcraft iii.exe') then
      local loaded, modules = pcall(enumModules, pid)
      if loaded and type(modules) == 'table' then
        for _,module in pairs(modules) do
          if basename == 'war3.exe' and tostring(module.Name):lower() == 'game.dll' then
            old[#old+1] = pid
            break
          elseif basename == 'warcraft iii.exe' and normalized(module.PathToFile) == legacyPath and not module.Is64Bit then
            current[#current+1] = pid
            break
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return old, current
end

local function chooseMode()
  local old, current = processes()
  if #current == 1 and #old == 0 then return '129' end
  if #old == 1 and #current == 0 then return 'original' end
  local foreground = getForegroundProcess()
  if #current == 1 and foreground == current[1] then return '129' end
  if #old == 1 and foreground == old[1] then return 'original' end
  local choices = createStringlist()
  choices.add('原版：1.20e / 1.24e / 1.27a')
  choices.add('新增：1.29.2.9231（Legacy）')
  local index = showSelectionList('选择游戏版本',
    '未检测到唯一游戏，请选择本次使用的版本。切换版本时重新打开修改器。', choices, false)
  choices.destroy()
  if index == 0 then return 'original' end
  if index == 1 then return '129' end
  return nil
end

local function execute(script, name)
  local chunk, errorText = load(script, name, 't', _G)
  if not chunk then error(errorText) end
  chunk()
end

local mode = chooseMode()
if not mode then closeCE(); return end
if mode == '129' then
  -- Original dwei/old Game.dll hotkeys stay disabled while new hotkeys run.
  WAR3_INTEGRATED_MODE = true
  execute(ADAPTER_SCRIPT, '@adapter_129.lua')
  return
end

execute(ORIGINAL_SCRIPT, '@original.lua')
CETrainer.Caption = 'Warcraft III 通用cheat | 原版 1.20e / 1.24e / 1.27a | 中文语音版'
local originalClick = CETrainer_CEToggleBox1Click
function CETrainer_CEToggleBox1Click(sender)
  local activating = CETrainer.CEToggleBox1.Checked
  setOriginalHotkeys(false)
  if activating then
    local old = processes()
    if #old ~= 1 then
      CETrainer.CEToggleBox1.Checked = false
      WAR3_TRAINER_VOICE.say('未找到原版游戏')
      showMessage('请先启动一份原版支持的 War3.exe，再激活。1.29.2 请重新打开修改器并选择新增版本。')
      return
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(openProcess, old[1])
    if not ok or result == false or getOpenedProcessID() ~= old[1] then
      CETrainer.CEToggleBox1.Checked = false
      WAR3_TRAINER_VOICE.say('游戏连接失败')
      showMessage('无法连接所选原版游戏，请检查游戏进程与运行权限。')
      return
    end
  end
  local ok, errorText = pcall(originalClick, sender)
  if not ok then
    CETrainer.CEToggleBox1.Checked = false
    WAR3_TRAINER_VOICE.say('原版激活未完成')
    showMessage('原版激活未完成：' .. tostring(errorText))
    return
  end
  setOriginalHotkeys(activating)
  WAR3_TRAINER_VOICE.say(activating and '原版修改器已激活' or '修改器已断开')
end
-- Bind the wrapper explicitly rather than depending on saved form-event lookup.
CETrainer.CEToggleBox1.OnClick = CETrainer_CEToggleBox1Click

-- Original command hotkeys keep their existing OnHotkey callback. These 18
-- entries had no OnPostHotkey handler; the new handler reports dispatch only.
local command = addressList.getMemoryRecordByID(199)
for op=1,18 do
  local action = op
  command.getHotkeyByID(op-1).onPostHotkey = function(sender)
    WAR3_TRAINER_VOICE.sent(action)
  end
end
```

`work/voice.lua`:

```lua
-- Chinese feedback through CE's existing local SAPI interface; no downloads.
-- CE 7.2 supports speak(text, flags). 11 = async + purge previous + XML.
local voice = {enabled=true}
local names = {'英雄升级','英雄属性设置','增加技能点','开启无敌','取消无敌','重置冷却',
  '补满生命魔法','新建同类型单位','移除单位','瞬移','创建单位','创建物品',
  '添加技能','升级技能','升级科技','设置资源','开启地图可见','复活英雄'}

function voice.say(text)
  if not voice.enabled or type(speak) ~= 'function' then return false end
  local escaped = tostring(text):gsub('&','&amp;'):gsub('<','&lt;'):gsub('>','&gt;')
  local ok = pcall(speak, '<voice required="Language=804">' .. escaped .. '</voice>', 11)
  return ok
end

function voice.success(op, result)
  local messages = {'英雄等级，' .. tostring(result.level or 0) .. '级','英雄属性已设置',
    '技能点已增加','无敌指令已执行','取消无敌指令已执行','冷却重置指令已执行',
    '生命魔法已补满','已新建同类型单位','单位已移除','瞬移指令已执行',
    '单位已创建','物品已创建','技能已添加',
    '已处理' .. tostring(result.applied or 0) .. '项技能',
    '已处理' .. tostring(result.applied or 0) .. '项科技',
    '黄金木材食物上限已设置','地图可见指令已执行',
    '已复活' .. tostring(result.applied or 0) .. '个英雄'}
  return voice.say(messages[op] or '操作已处理')
end

function voice.failure(code)
  local messages = {[103]='请先进入地图',[104]='输入不正确',[105]='请先选中单位',
    [106]='请先选中英雄',[108]='可能部分生效，请查看游戏',
    [110]='地图已变化，请重新连接',[112]='操作超时，结果未知',
    [113]='未连接游戏',[115]='游戏版本不匹配',[116]='操作异常，请查看游戏',
    [117]='没有适用目标'}
  return voice.say(messages[code] or '操作未完成')
end

function voice.sent(op)
  -- The original three backends have no completion ACK: announce dispatch only.
  return voice.say('已发送' .. (names[op] or '操作') .. '指令')
end

return voice

```
